88 T* FindOrCreate(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, const FName Name)
89 {
90 if (UWidget* Existing = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(Name))
91 {
92 return CastChecked<T>(Existing);
93 }
94 T* NewWidget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->ConstructWidget<T>(T::StaticClass(), Name);
95 Blueprint->OnVariableAdded(Name);
96 return NewWidget;

100 UWidgetBlueprint* EnsureBlueprint(const TCHAR* Path, const TCHAR* PackagePath,
101 const TCHAR* AssetName)
102 {
103 UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = LoadObject<UWidgetBlueprint>(nullptr, Path);
104 if (Blueprint == nullptr)
105 {
106 UWidgetBlueprintFactory* Factory = NewObject<UWidgetBlueprintFactory>();
107 Factory->ParentClass = UUserWidget::StaticClass();
108 FAssetToolsModule& AssetTools =
109 FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FAssetToolsModule>(TEXT("AssetTools"));
110 Blueprint = Cast<UWidgetBlueprint>(AssetTools.Get().CreateAsset(
111 AssetName, PackagePath, UWidgetBlueprint::StaticClass(), Factory));
112 }
113 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
114 {
115 return nullptr;
116 }
117 if (Cast<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget) == nullptr)
118 {
119 UCanvasPanel* Canvas = Blueprint->WidgetTree->ConstructWidget<UCanvasPanel>(
120 UCanvasPanel::StaticClass(), TEXT("MercenaryRootCanvas"));
121 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget = Canvas;
122 }
123 return Blueprint;
124 }

127 void PruneStaleVariables(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
128 {
129 TSet<FName> Live;
130 Blueprint->WidgetTree->ForEachWidget([&Live](UWidget* Widget)
131 {
132 if (Widget != nullptr)
133 {
134 Live.Add(Widget->GetFName());
135 }
136 });
137 TArray<FName> Stale;
138 for (const TPair<FName, FGuid>& Entry : Blueprint->WidgetVariableNameToGuidMap)
139 {
140 if (Live.Contains(Entry.Key) == false)
141 {
142 Stale.Add(Entry.Key);
143 }
144 }
145 for (const FName& Name : Stale)
146 {
147 Blueprint->WidgetVariableNameToGuidMap.Remove(Name);
148 Blueprint->OnVariableRemoved(Name);
149 }
150 }

180 int32 DeleteWidgetsCompletely(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint,
181 const TSet<UWidget*>& Widgets)
182 {
183 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Widgets.IsEmpty())
184 {
185 return 0;
186 }
187
188 // 부모를 지우면 자식까지 정리되므로 선택 집합에서 가장 바깥 뿌리만
189 // 넘긴다. 이미 부모를 잃은 이전 빌더의 orphan도 각각 뿌리로 정리된다.
190 TSet<UWidget*> Roots;
191 for (UWidget* Widget : Widgets)
192 {
193 if (Widget == nullptr)
194 {
195 continue;
196 }
197 bool bHasSelectedAncestor = false;
198 for (UWidget* Parent = Widget->GetParent(); Parent != nullptr;
199 Parent = Parent->GetParent())
200 {
201 if (Widgets.Contains(Parent))
202 {
203 bHasSelectedAncestor = true;
204 break;
205 }
206 }
207 if (bHasSelectedAncestor == false)
208 {
209 Roots.Add(Widget);
210 }
211 }
212
213 FWidgetBlueprintEditorUtils::DeleteWidgets(Blueprint, MoveTemp(Roots),
214 FWidgetBlueprintEditorUtils::EDeleteWidgetWarningType::DeleteSilently);
215 return Widgets.Num();
216 }

219 int32 RemoveTurnSpeedWidgets(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
220 {
221 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
222 {
223 return 0;
224 }
225 int32 Removed = 0;
226 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 10; ++Index)
227 {
228 const FString Tail = FString::Printf(TEXT("_%d"), Index);
229 // 자식을 먼저 지워 부모 제거 시 고아 위젯이 남지 않게 한다.
230 for (const FName Name : {
231 FName(TEXT("TurnSpeed") + Tail),
232 FName(TEXT("TurnSpeed") + Tail + TEXT("_Center")),
233 FName(TEXT("TurnSpeedIcon") + Tail),
234 FName(TEXT("TurnSpeedPlate") + Tail) })
235 {
236 if (UWidget* Widget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(Name))
237 {
238 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RemoveWidget(Widget);
239 ++Removed;
240 }
241 }
242 }
243 return Removed;
244 }

247 int32 RemoveRetiredQuickSkillWidgets(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
248 {
249 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
250 {
251 return 0;
252 }
253
254 TSet<UWidget*> RetiredWidgets;
255 // root traversal에 잡히지 않는 이전 빌더 orphan도 함께 걷는다.
256 for (UWidget* Widget : Blueprint->GetAllSourceWidgets())
257 {
258 if (Widget == nullptr)
259 {
260 continue;
261 }
262 const FString WidgetName = Widget->GetName();
263 if (WidgetName == TEXT("QuickSkillBar"))
264 {
265 RetiredWidgets.Add(Widget);
266 continue;
267 }
268 for (const TCHAR* Prefix : { TEXT("QuickSkillButton_"),
269 TEXT("QuickSkillCooldown_"), TEXT("QuickSkillIcon_"),
270 TEXT("QuickSkillFrame_"), TEXT("QuickSkillSlot_") })
271 {
272 if (WidgetName.StartsWith(Prefix))
273 {
274 RetiredWidgets.Add(Widget);
275 break;
276 }
277 }
278 }
279 return DeleteWidgetsCompletely(Blueprint, RetiredWidgets);
280 }

291 int32 NormalizeCenteredTextBounds(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
292 {
293 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
294 {
295 return 0;
296 }
297 TArray<UTextBlock*> TextBlocks;
298 Blueprint->WidgetTree->ForEachWidget([&TextBlocks](UWidget* Widget)
299 {
300 if (UTextBlock* Text = Cast<UTextBlock>(Widget))
301 {
302 TextBlocks.Add(Text);
303 }
304 });
305
306 int32 Normalized = 0;
307 for (UTextBlock* Text : TextBlocks)
308 {
309 const FName CenterName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%s_Center"),
310 *Text->GetName()));
311 UOverlay* Center = Cast<UOverlay>(
312 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(CenterName));
313 if (Center == nullptr)
314 {
315 continue;
316 }
317
318 UWidget* CenterChild = Text;
319 while (CenterChild != nullptr && CenterChild->GetParent() != Center)
320 {
321 CenterChild = CenterChild->GetParent();
322 }
323 if (CenterChild == nullptr)
324 {
325 continue;
326 }
327
328 UScaleBox* AutoFit = Cast<UScaleBox>(CenterChild);
329 if (AutoFit == nullptr && CenterChild == Text)
330 {
331 const int32 ChildIndex = Center->GetChildIndex(Text);
332 UPanelSlot* SlotTemplate = Text->Slot != nullptr
333 ? DuplicateObject<UPanelSlot>(Text->Slot, GetTransientPackage())
334 : nullptr;
335 if (ChildIndex == INDEX_NONE || SlotTemplate == nullptr)
336 {
337 continue;
338 }
339
340 const FName AutoFitName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%s_AutoFit"),
341 *Text->GetName()));
342 AutoFit = Cast<UScaleBox>(
343 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(AutoFitName));
344 if (AutoFit == nullptr)
345 {
346 AutoFit = Blueprint->WidgetTree->ConstructWidget<UScaleBox>(
347 UScaleBox::StaticClass(), AutoFitName);
348 Blueprint->OnVariableAdded(AutoFitName);
349 }
350 else if (UPanelWidget* OldParent = AutoFit->GetParent())
351 {
352 OldParent->RemoveChild(AutoFit);
353 }
354
355 Center->RemoveChildAt(ChildIndex);
356 if (Center->InsertChildAt(ChildIndex, AutoFit, SlotTemplate) == nullptr)
357 {
358 continue;
359 }
360 AutoFit->SetContent(Text);
361 CenterChild = AutoFit;
362 }
363 if (AutoFit == nullptr)
364 {
365 // 예상하지 못한 중간 래퍼는 트리를 훼손하지 않는다.
366 continue;
367 }
368
369 AutoFit->SetStretch(EStretch::ScaleToFitX);
370 AutoFit->SetStretchDirection(EStretchDirection::DownOnly);
371 // 세로로는 자르지 않는다. 저작된 칸 높이가 글꼴 줄 높이와 비슷하면
372 // 아래꼬리와 외곽선이 잘렸다. 가로는 ScaleToFitX 가 이미 막는다.
373 AutoFit->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::Inherit);
374 AutoFit->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
375 if (UOverlaySlot* Slot = Cast<UOverlaySlot>(CenterChild->Slot))
376 {
377 Slot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f));
378 Slot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Fill);
379 Slot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Fill);
380 }
381 if (UScaleBoxSlot* ScaleTextSlot = Cast<UScaleBoxSlot>(Text->Slot))
382 {
383 ScaleTextSlot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Center);
384 ScaleTextSlot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
385 }
386 Text->SetMargin(FMargin(0.f));
387 Text->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
388 Text->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
389 Text->SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(.5f));
390 ++Normalized;
391 }
392 return Normalized;
393 }

396 bool RepairResponsiveDetailTree(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
397 {
398 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
399 {
400 return false;
401 }
402 UCanvasPanel* Root = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
403 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("DetailPanelRoot")));
404 if (Root == nullptr)
405 {
406 return false;
407 }
408
409 if (UScaleBox* ExistingScale = Cast<UScaleBox>(
410 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("DetailResponsiveScale"))))
411 {
412 ExistingScale->SetStretch(EStretch::ScaleToFit);
413 ExistingScale->SetStretchDirection(EStretchDirection::Both);
414 ExistingScale->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::ClipToBoundsAlways);
415 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingScale->Slot))
416 {
417 Slot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
418 Slot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
419 Slot->SetAlignment(FVector2D::ZeroVector);
420 Slot->SetZOrder(10);
421 }
422 USizeBox* DesignSize = Cast<USizeBox>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
423 TEXT("DetailResponsiveDesignSize")));
424 UCanvasPanel* DesignCanvas = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
425 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("DetailResponsiveCanvas")));
426 if (DesignSize == nullptr || DesignCanvas == nullptr)
427 {
428 return false;
429 }
430 DesignSize->SetWidthOverride(1920.f);
431 DesignSize->SetHeightOverride(1080.f);
432 // 배경 암막은 디자인 판과 함께 축소하면 레터박스가 투명해진다.
433 // 이미 1차 수리된 에셋도 다시 실행하면 전 화면 루트로 복구한다.
434 for (const FName ScrimName : { FName(TEXT("DetailScrimBg")),
435 FName(TEXT("DetailScrimImage")) })
436 {
437 UWidget* Scrim = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(ScrimName);
438 if (Scrim == nullptr || Scrim->GetParent() == Root)
439 {
440 continue;
441 }
442 Scrim->GetParent()->RemoveChild(Scrim);
443 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = Root->AddChildToCanvas(Scrim))
444 {
445 Slot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
446 Slot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
447 Slot->SetAlignment(FVector2D::ZeroVector);
448 Slot->SetZOrder(0);
449 }
450 }
451 return true;
452 }

454 struct FAuthoredCanvasLayout
455 {
456 UWidget* Widget = nullptr;
457 FAnchors Anchors;
458 FMargin Offsets;
459 FVector2D Alignment = FVector2D::ZeroVector;
460 bool bAutoSize = false;
461 int32 ZOrder = 0;
462 };
463 TArray<FAuthoredCanvasLayout> ToMove;
464 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Root->GetChildrenCount(); ++Index)
465 {
466 UWidget* Child = Root->GetChildAt(Index);
467 if (Child == nullptr || Child->GetFName() == TEXT("DetailScrimBg")
468 || Child->GetFName() == TEXT("DetailScrimImage")
469 || Child->GetFName() == TEXT("DetailCloseCatch"))
470 {
471 continue;
472 }
473 UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Child->Slot);
474 if (Slot == nullptr)
475 {
476 continue;
477 }
478 FAuthoredCanvasLayout& Layout = ToMove.AddDefaulted_GetRef();
479 Layout.Widget = Child;
480 Layout.Anchors = Slot->GetAnchors();
481 Layout.Offsets = Slot->GetOffsets();
482 Layout.Alignment = Slot->GetAlignment();
483 Layout.bAutoSize = Slot->GetAutoSize();
484 Layout.ZOrder = Slot->GetZOrder();
485 }
486 for (const FAuthoredCanvasLayout& Layout : ToMove)
487 {
488 Root->RemoveChild(Layout.Widget);
489 }
490
491 UScaleBox* ResponsiveScale = Blueprint->WidgetTree->ConstructWidget<UScaleBox>(
492 UScaleBox::StaticClass(), TEXT("DetailResponsiveScale"));
493 ResponsiveScale->SetStretch(EStretch::ScaleToFit);
494 ResponsiveScale->SetStretchDirection(EStretchDirection::Both);
495 ResponsiveScale->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::ClipToBoundsAlways);
496 ResponsiveScale->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
497 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* ScaleSlot = Root->AddChildToCanvas(ResponsiveScale))
498 {
499 ScaleSlot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
500 ScaleSlot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
501 ScaleSlot->SetAlignment(FVector2D::ZeroVector);
502 ScaleSlot->SetZOrder(10);
503 }
504
505 USizeBox* DesignSize = Blueprint->WidgetTree->ConstructWidget<USizeBox>(
506 USizeBox::StaticClass(), TEXT("DetailResponsiveDesignSize"));
507 DesignSize->SetWidthOverride(1920.f);
508 DesignSize->SetHeightOverride(1080.f);
509 ResponsiveScale->AddChild(DesignSize);
510 if (UScaleBoxSlot* Slot = Cast<UScaleBoxSlot>(DesignSize->Slot))
511 {
512 Slot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Center);
513 Slot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
514 }
515
516 UCanvasPanel* DesignCanvas = Blueprint->WidgetTree->ConstructWidget<UCanvasPanel>(
517 UCanvasPanel::StaticClass(), TEXT("DetailResponsiveCanvas"));
518 DesignSize->SetContent(DesignCanvas);
519 for (const FAuthoredCanvasLayout& Layout : ToMove)
520 {
521 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = DesignCanvas->AddChildToCanvas(Layout.Widget))
522 {
523 Slot->SetAnchors(Layout.Anchors);
524 Slot->SetOffsets(Layout.Offsets);
525 Slot->SetAlignment(Layout.Alignment);
526 Slot->SetAutoSize(Layout.bAutoSize);
527 Slot->SetZOrder(Layout.ZOrder);
528 }
529 }
530 return ToMove.Num() > 0;
531 }

572 void RepairAuthoredRoundTurnLayout(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint,
573 UTexture2D* RoundBadgeTexture, UTexture2D* TurnTokenFrameTexture)
574 {
575 check(Blueprint != nullptr && Blueprint->WidgetTree != nullptr);
576 check(RoundBadgeTexture != nullptr && TurnTokenFrameTexture != nullptr);
577 RemoveTurnSpeedWidgets(Blueprint);
578
579 UCanvasPanel* Root = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
580 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget);
581 UCanvasPanel* RoundPanel = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
582 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundPanel")));
583 PlaceCanvas(Root, RoundPanel, FVector2D(18.f, 10.f),
584 FVector2D(218.f, 136.f), 100);
585 RoundPanel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
586
587 UOverlay* RoundPlateMount = CastChecked<UOverlay>(
588 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundPlateMount")));
589 PlaceCanvas(RoundPanel, RoundPlateMount, FVector2D::ZeroVector,
590 FVector2D(218.f, 68.f), 5);
591 RoundPlateMount->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
592
593 UImage* RoundPlate = CastChecked<UImage>(
594 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundPlate")));
595 EnsureParent(RoundPlateMount, RoundPlate);
596 FSlateBrush RoundPlateBrush = RoundPlate->GetBrush();
597 RoundPlateBrush.SetResourceObject(RoundBadgeTexture);
598 RoundPlateBrush.DrawAs = ESlateBrushDrawType::Image;
599 RoundPlateBrush.Margin = FMargin(0.f);
600 RoundPlate->SetBrush(RoundPlateBrush);
601 RoundPlate->SetColorAndOpacity(FLinearColor::White);
602 RoundPlate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
603 if (UOverlaySlot* Slot = CastChecked<UOverlaySlot>(RoundPlate->Slot))
604 {
605 Slot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Fill);
606 Slot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Fill);
607 Slot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f));
608 }
609
610 UOverlay* RoundTextCenter = CastChecked<UOverlay>(
611 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundText_Center")));
612 EnsureParent(RoundPlateMount, RoundTextCenter);
613 RoundTextCenter->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
614 if (UOverlaySlot* Slot = CastChecked<UOverlaySlot>(RoundTextCenter->Slot))
615 {
616 Slot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Fill);
617 Slot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Fill);
618 Slot->SetPadding(FMargin(22.f, 8.f, 22.f, 8.f));
619 }
620
621 UTextBlock* RoundText = CastChecked<UTextBlock>(
622 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundText")));
623 EnsureParent(RoundTextCenter, RoundText);
624 if (UOverlaySlot* Slot = CastChecked<UOverlaySlot>(RoundText->Slot))
625 {
626 Slot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Center);
627 Slot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
628 Slot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f, -5.f, 0.f, 0.f));
629 }
630 FSlateFontInfo RoundFont = UIFont::MakeProjectExact(RoundText->GetFont(), 30);
631 RoundFont.LetterSpacing = 0;
632 RoundFont.OutlineSettings.OutlineSize = 2;
633 RoundFont.OutlineSettings.OutlineColor = FLinearColor::Black;
634 RoundText->SetFont(RoundFont);
635 // 0823 확정: 배지는 "ROUND" 글자만. 라운드 수는 아래 숫자 칸이 맡는다.
636 RoundText->SetText(NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "RoundPreview", "ROUND"));

986 void RepairAuthoredSummaryStatusScrolls(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
987 {
988 check(Blueprint != nullptr && Blueprint->WidgetTree != nullptr);
989 for (const TCHAR* Prefix : { TEXT("Enemy"), TEXT("Ally") })
990 {
991 UCanvasPanel* Panel = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
992 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(FString(Prefix) + TEXT("Panel"))));
993 UScrollBox* Scroll = FindOrCreate<UScrollBox>(Blueprint,
994 FName(FString(Prefix) + TEXT("StatusScroll")));
995 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Scroll, FVector2D(14.f, 352.f),
996 FVector2D(140.f, 190.f), 15);
997 Scroll->SetOrientation(EOrientation::Orient_Vertical);
998 Scroll->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::ClipToBoundsAlways);
999 Scroll->SetScrollBarVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1000 Scroll->SetScrollbarThickness(FVector2D(4.f, 4.f));
1001 Scroll->SetConsumeMouseWheel(EConsumeMouseWheel::WhenScrollingPossible);
1002 Scroll->SetAnimateWheelScrolling(true);
1003 Scroll->SetAllowOverscroll(false);
1004 Scroll->SetAlwaysShowScrollbar(false);
1005 Scroll->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Visible);
1006
1007 // 카드가 펼쳐져도 체력을 읽을 수 있어야 하므로 요약판 HP도 남긴다.
1008 for (const TCHAR* Suffix : { TEXT("HPBackMount"), TEXT("HPBack"),
1009 TEXT("HPBar"), TEXT("HPText_Center"), TEXT("HPText") })
1010 {
1011 if (UWidget* Widget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1012 FName(FString(Prefix) + Suffix)))
1013 {
1014 Widget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1015 }
1016 }
1017 // HP→금속 프레임→글자 순으로 그리면 HP는 넓게 차오르되 금속
1018 // 테두리를 덮지 않는다. 프레임을 시각적 마스크로 사용한다.
1019 if (UProgressBar* HPBar = Cast<UProgressBar>(
1020 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1021 FName(FString(Prefix) + TEXT("HPBar")))))
1022 {
1023 if (UOverlaySlot* HPSlot = Cast<UOverlaySlot>(HPBar->Slot))
1024 {
1025 HPSlot->SetPadding(FMargin(8.f));
1026 if (UOverlay* Mount = Cast<UOverlay>(HPBar->GetParent()))
1027 {
1028 UWidget* Frame = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1029 FName(FString(Prefix) + TEXT("HPBack")));
1030 const int32 FrameIndex = Mount->GetChildIndex(Frame);
1031 const int32 BarIndex = Mount->GetChildIndex(HPBar);
1032 if (Frame != nullptr && FrameIndex != INDEX_NONE
1033 && BarIndex != INDEX_NONE && FrameIndex < BarIndex)
1034 {
1035 UPanelSlot* FrameSlot = Frame->Slot;
1036 Mount->RemoveChildAt(FrameIndex);
1037 Mount->InsertChildAt(
1038 Mount->GetChildIndex(HPBar) + 1, Frame, FrameSlot);
1039 }
1040 }
1041 }
1042 }
1043
1044 // HP를 없앴던 판이 AP/속도 행을 위로 당겨 저장했을 수 있다.
1045 for (const TCHAR* Suffix : { TEXT("APPlateMount"), TEXT("APPlate"),
1046 TEXT("APText_Center"), TEXT("APText"), TEXT("SpeedPlateMount"),
1047 TEXT("SpeedPlate"), TEXT("SpeedIcon"), TEXT("SpeedText_Center"),
1048 TEXT("SpeedText") })
1049 {
1050 if (UWidget* Widget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1051 FName(FString(Prefix) + Suffix)))
1052 {
1053 FWidgetTransform Transform;
1054 if (FString(Suffix).EndsWith(TEXT("Icon")))
1055 {
1056 Transform.Scale = FVector2D(1.2f, 1.2f);
1057 }
1058 Widget->SetRenderTransform(Transform);
1059 Widget->SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(.5f, .5f));
1060 }
1061 }
1062
1063 for (const TCHAR* Suffix : { TEXT("StatusLabel"),
1064 TEXT("StatusLabel_Center"), TEXT("Status"), TEXT("Status_Center") })
1065 {
1066 if (UWidget* Legacy = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1067 FName(FString(Prefix) + Suffix)))
1068 {
1069 Legacy->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1070 }
1071 }
1072 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 3; ++Index)
1073 {
1074 const FString Base = FString::Printf(TEXT("%sStatus"), Prefix);
1075 const FName LegacyNames[] = {
1076 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sFrame_%dMount"), *Base, Index)),
1077 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sFrame_%d"), *Base, Index)),
1078 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sIcon_%d"), *Base, Index)),
1079 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sCount_%d_Center"), *Base, Index)),
1080 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sCount_%d_AutoFit"), *Base, Index)),
1081 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sCount_%d"), *Base, Index)),
1082 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%sButton_%d"), *Base, Index)),
1083 };
1084 for (const FName LegacyName : LegacyNames)
1085 {
1086 if (UWidget* Legacy = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(LegacyName))
1087 {
1088 Legacy->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
1089 Legacy->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1090 }
1091 }
1092 }
1093 }
1094 }

1101 void RepairAuthoredMercenaryCriticalRow(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint,
1102 UTexture2D* DescriptionPlateTexture)
1103 {
1104 check(Blueprint != nullptr && Blueprint->WidgetTree != nullptr);
1105 check(DescriptionPlateTexture != nullptr);
1106 UCanvasPanel* DetailSection = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
1107 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercDetailSection")));
1108 if (DetailSection == nullptr)
1109 {
1110 return;
1111 }
1112
1113 // 앞의 세 수치 행은 FrameMount 안에서 원화를 AspectFit 한다. 치명타만
1114 // 이미지를 캔버스에 직접 놓으면 같은 620x68 슬롯이어도 브러시 희망
1115 // 크기로 그려져 오른쪽으로 길게 튀어나온다. 마지막 수치 행의 마운트
1116 // 좌표/크기를 복제하고 한 행 아래에 같은 계보로 배치한다.
1117 FVector2D RowPosition(1080.f, 576.f);
1118 FVector2D RowSize(620.f, 68.f);
1119 UOverlay* ReferenceMount = Cast<UOverlay>(
1120 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryChip2FrameMount")));
1121 if (const UCanvasPanelSlot* ReferenceSlot = ReferenceMount != nullptr
1122 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ReferenceMount->Slot) : nullptr)
1123 {
1124 RowPosition = ReferenceSlot->GetPosition() + FVector2D(0.f, 82.f);
1125 RowSize = ReferenceSlot->GetSize();
1126 }
1127 const FVector2D CritIconOffset(26.f, 10.f);
1128 const FVector2D ExistingStatIconOffset(36.f, 10.f);
1129 const FVector2D StatIconSize(46.f, 46.f);
1130
1131 // 네 위젯의 박스 좌표만 같게 두면 치명타 원화의 왼쪽 투명 여백 때문에
1132 // 실제 그림은 치명타만 오른쪽에 보인다. HP/AP/속도 원화는 그 여백이
1133 // 없으므로 10px 오른쪽으로 보정해 화면상의 불투명 그림 중심을 맞춘다.
1134 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 3; ++Index)
1135 {
1136 UWidget* StatMount = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1137 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryChip%dFrameMount"), Index)));
1138 UImage* StatIcon = Cast<UImage>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1139 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryStatIcon_%d"), Index))));
1140 const UCanvasPanelSlot* StatMountSlot = StatMount != nullptr
1141 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(StatMount->Slot) : nullptr;
1142 if (StatIcon != nullptr && StatMountSlot != nullptr)
1143 {
1144 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, StatIcon,
1145 StatMountSlot->GetPosition() + ExistingStatIconOffset,
1146 StatIconSize, 9);
1147 StatIcon->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
1148 StatIcon->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1149 }
1150 }
1151
1152 UOverlay* PlateMount = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint,
1153 TEXT("MercenaryCritPlateMount"));
1154 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, PlateMount, RowPosition, RowSize, 8);
1155 PlateMount->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1156
1157 UImage* Plate = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryCritPlate"));
1158 EnsureParent(PlateMount, Plate);
1159 if (const UImage* ReferencePlate = Cast<UImage>(
1160 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryChip2Frame"))))
1161 {
1162 Plate->SetBrush(ReferencePlate->GetBrush());
1163 if (const UOverlaySlot* ReferencePlateSlot =
1164 Cast<UOverlaySlot>(ReferencePlate->Slot))
1165 {
1166 SetOverlayLayout(Plate, ReferencePlateSlot->GetPadding(),
1167 ReferencePlateSlot->GetHorizontalAlignment(),
1168 ReferencePlateSlot->GetVerticalAlignment());
1169 }
1170 }
1171 else
1172 {
1173 SetOverlayLayout(Plate, FMargin(0.f), HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1174 }
1175 // 구형 행 배경에는 노란 마름모가 이미지에 박혀 있었다. 범용 무지 행으로
1176 // 갈아 끼운 뒤 별도 아이콘을 얹어야 실제 에셋 교체가 보인다.
1177 // 인라인 최종본의 수치 행은 빌더 기본 텍스처와 다른 브러시를 쓴다.
1178 // 바로 위 HP 행을 복사해야 구형 치명타 판에 박힌 노란 마름모까지 빠지고
1179 // 네 행의 모양도 정확히 같아진다.
1180 if (const UImage* ReferencePlate = Cast<UImage>(
1181 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryChip0Frame"))))
1182 {
1183 Plate->SetBrush(ReferencePlate->GetBrush());
1184 }
1185 else
1186 {
1187 Plate->SetBrushFromTexture(DescriptionPlateTexture, false);
1188 }
1189 Plate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1190
1191 UImage* Icon = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryCritIcon"));
1192 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, Icon, RowPosition + CritIconOffset,
1193 StatIconSize, 9);
1194 Icon->SetBrushFromTexture(EnsureCriticalIconTexture(), false);
1195 Icon->SetColorAndOpacity(FLinearColor::White);
1196 Icon->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
1197 Icon->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1198 // 디자이너 최종본의 옛 노란 마름모는 MercenaryCrit*가 아니라 공용
1199 // 네 번째 스탯 아이콘 이름으로 남아 있었다.
1200 if (UWidget* LegacyIcon = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1201 TEXT("MercenaryStatIcon_3")))
1202 {
1203 LegacyIcon->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1204 }
1205
1206 if (UTextBlock* Label = Cast<UTextBlock>(
1207 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryCritLabel"))))
1208 {
1209 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, Label, RowPosition + FVector2D(82.f, 4.f),
1210 FVector2D(145.f, 58.f), 9);
1211 }
1212 if (UTextBlock* Value = Cast<UTextBlock>(

1222 void RepairAuthoredActionButtonLabels(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)

1225 struct FActionButtonNames

1270 void RepairAuthoredRightHUDLayout(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint,
1271 UTexture2D* OptionsRailFrameTexture)
1272 {
1273 check(Blueprint != nullptr && Blueprint->WidgetTree != nullptr);
1274 check(OptionsRailFrameTexture != nullptr);
1275
1276 UCanvasPanel* Root = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
1277 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget);
1278 auto SetOverlaySlot = [](UWidget* Widget, const FMargin Padding,
1279 const EHorizontalAlignment Horizontal,
1280 const EVerticalAlignment Vertical)
1281 {
1282 UOverlaySlot* Slot = CastChecked<UOverlaySlot>(Widget->Slot);
1283 Slot->SetPadding(Padding);
1284 Slot->SetHorizontalAlignment(Horizontal);
1285 Slot->SetVerticalAlignment(Vertical);
1286 };
1287 auto ResetVisualTransform = [](UWidget* Widget, const FVector2D Pivot)
1288 {
1289 Widget->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
1290 Widget->SetRenderTransformPivot(Pivot);
1291 Widget->SetRenderOpacity(1.f);
1292 Widget->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::Inherit);
1293 };
1294
1295 // 우상단 설정 바. 네 단추를 모두 같은 Overlay 입력 계층에 둔다.
1296 // 설정 단추만 Canvas 자식으로 남으면 프레임 위 다른 자식의 hit test에
1297 // 가려져 모바일에서 눌리지 않는 회귀가 생긴다.
1298 UCanvasPanel* Objective = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
1299 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("ObjectivePanel")));
1300 PlaceCanvas(Root, Objective, FVector2D(-570.f, 2.f),
1301 FVector2D(RunOptionsRail::Width, RunOptionsRail::Height), 90);
1302 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = CastChecked<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Objective->Slot))
1303 {
1304 Slot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(1.f, 0.f));
1305 Slot->SetAlignment(FVector2D::ZeroVector);
1306 }
1307 Objective->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1308 FWidgetTransform ObjectiveTransform;
1309 ObjectiveTransform.Scale = FVector2D(.75f, .75f);
1310 Objective->SetRenderTransform(ObjectiveTransform);
1311 Objective->SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(1.f, 0.f));
1312 Objective->SetRenderOpacity(1.f);
1313 Objective->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::Inherit);
1314 // 0811 donor에는 없는 구형 임무 장식이다. 그래프/런타임 이름 호환을
1315 // 위해 객체는 남기되 우측 설정 바와 겹치지 않도록 항상 접어 둔다.
1316 for (const FName RetiredName : { FName(TEXT("ObjectivePlate")),
1317 FName(TEXT("ObjectiveText_Center")), FName(TEXT("ObjectiveText")) })
1318 {
1319 if (UWidget* Retired = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(RetiredName))
1320 {
1321 Retired->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1322 }
1323 }
1324
1325 UOverlay* OptionsMount = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint,
1326 TEXT("OptionsRailFrameMount"));
1327 PlaceCanvas(Objective, OptionsMount, FVector2D::ZeroVector,
1328 FVector2D::ZeroVector, 1);
1329 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = CastChecked<UCanvasPanelSlot>(OptionsMount->Slot))
1330 {
1331 Slot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
1332 Slot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
1333 }
1334 OptionsMount->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1335 ResetVisualTransform(OptionsMount, FVector2D(.5f, .5f));
1336
1337 UImage* OptionsFrame = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
1338 TEXT("OptionsRailFrame"));
1339 EnsureParent(OptionsMount, OptionsFrame);
1340 OptionsFrame->SetBrushFromTexture(OptionsRailFrameTexture, false);
1341 OptionsFrame->SetColorAndOpacity(FLinearColor::White);
1342 OptionsFrame->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1343 SetOverlaySlot(OptionsFrame, FMargin(0.f), HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1344
1345 // 눌리는 사각형은 아이콘과 같은 배율로 함께 움직여야 한다. 레일을
1346 // 1.2배로 키우면서 프레임과 아이콘만 옮기고 이 사각형은 옛 좌표로
1347 // 남겨 둔 탓에, 네 칸이 서로 겹쳐 아이콘 위에 커서를 올려도 옆 칸이
1348 // 잡혔다(0824 검수 4번). 좌표는 RunOptionsRail 한 곳에서만 온다.
1349 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < RunOptionsRail::SlotCount; ++Index)
1350 {
1351 UButton* Button = CastChecked<UButton>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1352 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MenuButton_%d"), Index))));
1353 EnsureParent(OptionsMount, Button);
1354 // Overlay 안의 여백은 (왼쪽, 위, 오른쪽, 아래)다. 레일 크기에서
1355 // 사각형을 빼면 남는 쪽 여백이 된다.
1356 const FVector2D Position = RunOptionsRail::ButtonPosition(Index);
1357 const FVector2D Size = RunOptionsRail::ButtonSize();
1358 SetOverlaySlot(Button, FMargin(Position.X, Position.Y,
1359 RunOptionsRail::Width - Position.X - Size.X,
1360 RunOptionsRail::Height - Position.Y - Size.Y),
1361 HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1362 Button->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Visible);
1363 }
1364
1365 struct FIconLayout
1366 {
1367 FName Name;
1368 FVector2D Position;
1369 FVector2D Size;
1370 };
1371 const FName IconNames[RunOptionsRail::SlotCount] = {
1372 TEXT("MenuMapIcon"), TEXT("MenuMercenaryIcon"),
1373 TEXT("MenuMonsterIcon"), TEXT("MenuSettingsIcon") };
1374 // 이 아이콘들은 판 한가운데를 기준으로 놓인다. 공용 좌표는 좌상단
1375 // 기준이므로 레일 중심을 빼서 옮긴다.
1376 const FVector2D RailCenter(
1377 RunOptionsRail::Width * .5f, RunOptionsRail::Height * .5f);
1378 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < RunOptionsRail::SlotCount; ++Index)
1379 {
1380 UImage* Icon = CastChecked<UImage>(
1381 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(IconNames[Index]));
1382 PlaceCanvas(Objective, Icon,
1383 RunOptionsRail::IconPosition(Index) - RailCenter,
1384 RunOptionsRail::IconSize(Index), 31);
1385 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = CastChecked<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Icon->Slot))
1386 {
1387 Slot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(.5f, .5f));
1388 }
1389 Icon->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1390 }
1391
1392 // 설정 바와 하단 행동 단추 사이의 좁은 세로 공간을 쓴다. 양 진영은
1393 // 같은 자리를 번갈아 사용한다.
1394 for (const FName PanelName : { FName(TEXT("EnemyPanel")),
1395 FName(TEXT("AllyPanel")) })
1396 {
1397 UCanvasPanel* Panel = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
1398 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(PanelName));
1399 PlaceCanvas(Root, Panel, FVector2D(0.f, 150.f),
1400 FVector2D(168.f, 550.f), 60);
1401 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = CastChecked<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Panel->Slot))
1402 {
1403 Slot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(1.f, 0.f));
1404 Slot->SetAlignment(FVector2D(1.f, 0.f));
1405 }
1406 Panel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1407 ResetVisualTransform(Panel, FVector2D(1.f, 0.f));
1408 const FString Prefix = PanelName.ToString().LeftChop(5);
1409 // 스킬 카드가 열린 동안에도 체력을 읽을 수 있도록 요약판 HP 행을
1410 // 유지한다. 상태 목록은 아래 전용 스크롤이 차지한다.
1411 for (const TCHAR* Suffix : { TEXT("HPBackMount"), TEXT("HPBack"),
1412 TEXT("HPBar"), TEXT("HPText_Center"), TEXT("HPText") })
1413 {
1414 if (UWidget* HPWidget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(
1415 *FString::Printf(TEXT("%s%s"), *Prefix, Suffix))))
1416 {
1417 HPWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1418 }
1419 }
1420 for (const TCHAR* Suffix : { TEXT("PortraitFrame"), TEXT("Portrait") })
1421 {
1422 if (UWidget* Widget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(
1423 *FString::Printf(TEXT("%s%s"), *Prefix, Suffix))))
1424 {
1425 FWidgetTransform Transform;
1426 Transform.Scale = FVector2D(1.22f, 1.22f);
1427 Widget->SetRenderTransform(Transform);
1428 Widget->SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(.5f, .5f));
1429 }
1430 }
1431 for (const TCHAR* Suffix : { TEXT("APPlateMount"), TEXT("APPlate"),
1432 TEXT("APText_Center"), TEXT("APText"), TEXT("SpeedPlateMount"),
1433 TEXT("SpeedPlate"), TEXT("SpeedIcon"), TEXT("SpeedText_Center"),
1434 TEXT("SpeedText") })
1435 {
1436 if (UWidget* Widget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(
1437 *FString::Printf(TEXT("%s%s"), *Prefix, Suffix))))
1438 {
1439 FWidgetTransform Transform;
1440 if (FString(Suffix).EndsWith(TEXT("Icon")))
1441 {
1442 Transform.Scale = FVector2D(1.2f, 1.2f);
1443 }
1444 Widget->SetRenderTransform(Transform);
1445 Widget->SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(.5f, .5f));
1446 }
1447 }
1448 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 3; ++Index)
1449 {
1450 for (const TCHAR* Kind : { TEXT("Frame"), TEXT("Icon"),
1451 TEXT("Count"), TEXT("Button") })
1452 {
1453 if (UWidget* StatusWidget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(
1454 *FString::Printf(TEXT("%sStatus%s_%d"),
1455 *Prefix, Kind, Index))))
1456 {
1457 StatusWidget->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
1458 StatusWidget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1459 }
1460 }
1461 if (UWidget* StatusButton = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(
1462 *FString::Printf(TEXT("%sStatusButton_%d"),
1463 *Prefix, Index))))
1464 {
1465 StatusButton->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1466 }
1467 }
1468 }

1472 // 정한다. 스킬/확정은 좌하단, 턴 종료는 우하단이다.
1473 const FVector2D ActionSize(396.172241f, 150.f);
1474 auto PlaceActionPanel = [&](const FName PanelName,
1475 const FName MountName, const FVector2D Position,
1476 const FAnchors Anchors, const FVector2D Alignment)
1477 {
1478 UCanvasPanel* Panel = FindOrCreate<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint, PanelName);
1479 PlaceCanvas(Root, Panel, Position, ActionSize, 60);
1480 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = CastChecked<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Panel->Slot))
1481 {
1482 Slot->SetAnchors(Anchors);
1483 Slot->SetAlignment(Alignment);
1484 }
1485 Panel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1486 ResetVisualTransform(Panel, FVector2D(.5f, .5f));
1487
1488 UOverlay* Mount = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint, MountName);
1489 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Mount, FVector2D::ZeroVector, ActionSize, 0);
1490 Mount->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1491 ResetVisualTransform(Mount, FVector2D(.5f, .5f));
1492 return Mount;
1493 };

1659 bool RepairTurnAPPlacement(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
1660 {
1661 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
1662 {
1663 return false;
1664 }

1666 UScaleBox* TurnAPScale = Cast<UScaleBox>(
1667 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("TurnAPScale")));
1668 if (Root == nullptr || TurnAPScale == nullptr)

1672
1673 TurnAPScale->SetStretch(EStretch::ScaleToFit);

1675 PlaceCanvas(Root, TurnAPScale, FVector2D(18.f, 164.f),
1676 FVector2D(800.f, 97.f), 2);

1681 void RepairAuthoredPrimaryCombatControls(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
1682 {
1683 check(Blueprint != nullptr && Blueprint->WidgetTree != nullptr);
1684 UCanvasPanel* Root = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
1685 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget);
1686 RemoveRetiredQuickSkillWidgets(Blueprint);
1687
1688 // ROUND/턴 바 바로 아래의 좌상단에 고정한다. 왼쪽 AP 전용 배지와
1689 // 오른쪽 15칸 레일을 800x97 안에 함께 넣어 중앙 Move 카드와 겹치지 않는다.
1690 check(RepairTurnAPPlacement(Blueprint));
1691 if (UTextBlock* TurnAPText = Cast<UTextBlock>(
1692 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("TurnAPText"))))
1693 {
1694 TurnAPText->SetMargin(FMargin(0.f));
1695 TurnAPText->SetFont(UIFont::MakeProjectExact(
1696 TurnAPText->GetFont(), 19));
1697 TurnAPText->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
1698 }
1699
1700 // 15칸을 5 | 5 | 5로 읽을 수 있도록 각 묶음 사이에 11px 여백과
1701 // 밝은 금속 구분선을 둔다. 보석과 점등 레이어는 같은 고정 좌표를 쓴다.
1702 if (UCanvasPanel* PipRow = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
1703 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("TurnAPPipRow"))))
1704 {
1705 constexpr int32 PipCount = 15;
1706 constexpr int32 PipsPerGroup = 5;
1707 constexpr float PipStep = 27.f;
1708 constexpr float GroupGap = 9.f;
1709 const FVector2D PipOrigin(.5f, 1.f);
1710 const FVector2D PipSize(25.f, 32.f);
1711 constexpr float PipRowWidth = 424.f;
1712 constexpr float PlateWidth = 568.421f;
1713 constexpr float RailX = 116.f;
1714 constexpr float RailY = 5.5f;
1715 constexpr float RailHeight = 58.f;
1716 constexpr float BadgeWidth = 132.f;
1717 constexpr float BadgeHeight = 68.8995f;
1718
1719 // 수동 편집이나 이전 시안에서 16칸 이상이 남아 있어도 빌더 한 번으로
1720 // 정확히 15칸 계약으로 돌아오게 한다.
1721 TSet<UWidget*> OverflowPips;
1722 for (UWidget* Widget : Blueprint->GetAllSourceWidgets())
1723 {
1724 if (Widget == nullptr)
1725 {
1726 continue;
1727 }
1728 const FString WidgetName = Widget->GetName();
1729 for (const TCHAR* Prefix : { TEXT("TurnAPPip"),
1730 TEXT("TurnAPPipUsed"), TEXT("TurnAPPipGlow") })
1731 {
1732 const FString PrefixWithSeparator = FString(Prefix) + TEXT("_");
1733 if (WidgetName.StartsWith(PrefixWithSeparator) == false)
1734 {
1735 continue;
1736 }
1737 const FString Suffix = WidgetName.RightChop(
1738 PrefixWithSeparator.Len());
1739 if (Suffix.IsNumeric() && FCString::Atoi(*Suffix) >= PipCount)
1740 {
1741 OverflowPips.Add(Widget);
1742 }
1743 }
1744 }
1745 DeleteWidgetsCompletely(Blueprint, OverflowPips);
1746
1747 // 참고안은 하나의 연속 레일에 선만 둔다. 이전 시안의 어두운
1748 // 그룹 홈은 모두 지우고 구분선은 정확히 2개만 남긴다.
1749 TSet<UWidget*> OverflowGroups;
1750 for (UWidget* Widget : Blueprint->GetAllSourceWidgets())
1751 {
1752 if (Widget == nullptr)
1753 {
1754 continue;
1755 }
1756 const FString WidgetName = Widget->GetName();
1757 for (const TCHAR* Prefix : { TEXT("TurnAPGroupWell"),
1758 TEXT("TurnAPGroupSeparatorShadow"),
1759 TEXT("TurnAPGroupSeparator") })
1760 {
1761 const FString PrefixWithSeparator = FString(Prefix) + TEXT("_");
1762 if (WidgetName.StartsWith(PrefixWithSeparator) == false)
1763 {
1764 continue;
1765 }
1766 const FString Suffix = WidgetName.RightChop(
1767 PrefixWithSeparator.Len());
1768 const int32 MaxCount = FString(Prefix) == TEXT("TurnAPGroupWell")
1769 ? 0 : 2;
1770 if (Suffix.IsNumeric() && FCString::Atoi(*Suffix) >= MaxCount)
1771 {
1772 OverflowGroups.Add(Widget);
1773 }
1774 }
1775 }
1776 DeleteWidgetsCompletely(Blueprint, OverflowGroups);
1777
1778 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* RowSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(PipRow->Slot))
1779 {
1780 RowSlot->SetPosition(FVector2D(136.f, 17.f));
1781 RowSlot->SetSize(FVector2D(PipRowWidth, 34.f));
1782 }
1783 UOverlay* PlateMount = Cast<UOverlay>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1784 TEXT("TurnAPPlateMount")));
1785 UCanvasPanel* TurnAPPanel = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
1786 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("TurnAPPanel")));
1787 if (PlateMount != nullptr && TurnAPPanel != nullptr)
1788 {
1789 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* PlateSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(PlateMount->Slot))
1790 {
1791 PlateSlot->SetPosition(FVector2D(RailX, RailY));
1792 PlateSlot->SetSize(FVector2D(PlateWidth - RailX, RailHeight));
1793 }
1794
1795 // ROUND의 좌우 금속 캡과 주황 테두리 전체를 재사용해
1796 // AP 전용 배지를 만든다. 긴 AP 원화를 배지로 찌그러뜨리지 않는다.
1797 UOverlay* BadgeMount = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint,
1798 TEXT("TurnAPBadgeMount"));
1799 PlaceCanvas(TurnAPPanel, BadgeMount, FVector2D::ZeroVector,
1800 FVector2D(BadgeWidth, BadgeHeight), 20);
1801 BadgeMount->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
1802
1803 UImage* BadgePlate = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
1804 TEXT("TurnAPBadgePlate"));
1805 EnsureParent(BadgeMount, BadgePlate);
1806 SetOverlayLayout(BadgePlate, FMargin(0.f), HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1807 if (UImage* RoundPlate = Cast<UImage>(
1808 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundPlate"))))
1809 {
1810 FSlateBrush BadgeBrush = RoundPlate->GetBrush();
1811 // ROUND 원본(1839x573)의 장식 전체를 작은 AP 배지 안에 보인다.
1812 // Box 9-slice는 실제 원본 크기로 테두리를 계산해 작은 배지의
1813 // 중앙을 접으므로 이 전용 배지만 전체 이미지 축소를 사용한다.
1814 BadgeBrush.DrawAs = ESlateBrushDrawType::Image;
1815 BadgeBrush.Margin = FMargin(0.f);
1816 BadgePlate->SetBrush(BadgeBrush);
1817 }
1818 BadgePlate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1819
1820 UOverlay* LabelCenter = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint,
1821 TEXT("TurnAPLabel_Center"));
1822 EnsureParent(BadgeMount, LabelCenter);
1823 SetOverlayLayout(LabelCenter, FMargin(12.f, 6.f, 12.f, 34.f),
1824 HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1825 UTextBlock* APLabel = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint,
1826 TEXT("TurnAPLabel"));
1827 EnsureParent(LabelCenter, APLabel);
1828 SetOverlayLayout(APLabel, FMargin(0.f), HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1829 APLabel->SetText(FText::FromString(TEXT("AP")));
1830 FSlateFontInfo LabelFont = UIFont::MakeProjectExact(
1831 APLabel->GetFont(), 14);
1832 LabelFont.OutlineSettings.OutlineSize = 1;
1833 LabelFont.OutlineSettings.OutlineColor = FLinearColor::Black;
1834 APLabel->SetFont(LabelFont);
1835 APLabel->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
1836 APLabel->SetColorAndOpacity(FSlateColor(
1837 FLinearColor(.82f, .58f, .31f, 1.f)));
1838 APLabel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1839
1840 if (UWidget* TextCenter = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1841 TEXT("TurnAPText_Center")))
1842 {
1843 EnsureParent(BadgeMount, TextCenter);
1844 SetOverlayLayout(TextCenter, FMargin(10.f, 26.f, 10.f, 5.f),
1845 HAlign_Fill, VAlign_Fill);
1846 }
1847 }
1848 // 위에서 새로 만든 AP 라벨도 다른 HUD 문구와 같은
1849 // Center -> AutoFit -> Text 계약에 편입한다.
1850 NormalizeCenteredTextBounds(Blueprint);
1851
1852 UMaterialInterface* APGemFlashMaterial = LoadObject<UMaterialInterface>(
1853 nullptr, APGemFlashMaterialPath);
1854 UImage* PipTemplate = Cast<UImage>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1855 TEXT("TurnAPPip_0")));
1856 UImage* UsedTemplate = Cast<UImage>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1857 TEXT("TurnAPPipUsed_0")));
1858 check(PipTemplate != nullptr && UsedTemplate != nullptr);
1859
1860 for (int32 SeparatorIndex = 0; SeparatorIndex < 2; ++SeparatorIndex)
1861 {
1862 const int32 NextPipIndex = (SeparatorIndex + 1) * PipsPerGroup;
1863 const float NextPipX = PipOrigin.X + PipStep * NextPipIndex
1864 + GroupGap * (SeparatorIndex + 1);
1865 const float PreviousPipRight = PipOrigin.X
1866 + PipStep * (NextPipIndex - 1)
1867 + GroupGap * SeparatorIndex + PipSize.X;
1868 const float SeparatorCenter = (PreviousPipRight + NextPipX) * .5f;
1869
1870 UBorder* SeparatorShadow = FindOrCreate<UBorder>(Blueprint,
1871 FName(*FString::Printf(
1872 TEXT("TurnAPGroupSeparatorShadow_%d"), SeparatorIndex)));
1873 PlaceCanvas(PipRow, SeparatorShadow,
1874 FVector2D(SeparatorCenter - 3.5f, .5f), FVector2D(7.f, 33.f), 14);
1875 SeparatorShadow->SetBrushColor(
1876 FLinearColor(.025f, .012f, .004f, .95f));
1877 SeparatorShadow->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1878
1879 UBorder* Separator = FindOrCreate<UBorder>(Blueprint,
1880 FName(*FString::Printf(
1881 TEXT("TurnAPGroupSeparator_%d"), SeparatorIndex)));
1882 PlaceCanvas(PipRow, Separator,
1883 FVector2D(SeparatorCenter - 2.f, 2.f), FVector2D(4.f, 30.f), 15);
1884 Separator->SetBrushColor(FLinearColor(.78f, .72f, .61f, 1.f));
1885 Separator->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1886 }
1887
1888 for (int32 PipIndex = 0; PipIndex < PipCount; ++PipIndex)
1889 {
1890 const FVector2D Position = PipOrigin
1891 + FVector2D(PipStep * PipIndex
1892 + GroupGap * (PipIndex / PipsPerGroup), 0.f);
1893 UImage* UsedPip = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
1894 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("TurnAPPipUsed_%d"), PipIndex)));
1895 PlaceCanvas(PipRow, UsedPip, Position, PipSize, 10);
1896 UsedPip->SetBrush(UsedTemplate->GetBrush());
1897 UsedPip->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1898
1899 UImage* Pip = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
1900 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("TurnAPPip_%d"), PipIndex)));
1901 PlaceCanvas(PipRow, Pip, Position, PipSize, 11);
1902 Pip->SetBrush(PipTemplate->GetBrush());
1903 Pip->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1904
1905 UImage* Glow = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
1906 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("TurnAPPipGlow_%d"), PipIndex)));
1907 PlaceCanvas(PipRow, Glow, Position, PipSize, 20);
1908 if (APGemFlashMaterial != nullptr)
1909 {
1910 Glow->SetBrushFromMaterial(APGemFlashMaterial);
1911 }
1912 Glow->SetColorAndOpacity(FLinearColor::White);
1913 Glow->SetRenderOpacity(0.f);
1914 Glow->SetRenderTransformPivot(FVector2D(.5f));
1915 Glow->SetRenderTransformAngle(0.f);
1916 Glow->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1917 }
1918 }
1919
1920 const FVector2D CardSize(200.f, 228.f);
1921 const FVector2D CardPositions[] = {
1922 FVector2D(-95.9809f, -327.8756f),
1923 FVector2D(-376.1722f, -184.3349f),
1924 FVector2D(168.1340f, -184.3349f),
1925 FVector2D(-376.1722f, 90.1148f),
1926 FVector2D(168.1340f, 90.1148f),
1927 FVector2D(-95.9809f, 232.5072f),
1928 };
1929 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < UE_ARRAY_COUNT(CardPositions); ++Index)
1930 {
1931 UCanvasPanel* Card = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1932 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("CommandCard_%d"), Index))));
1933 if (Card == nullptr)
1934 {
1935 continue;
1936 }
1937
1938 PlaceCanvas(Root, Card, CardPositions[Index], CardSize, 0);
1939 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* CardSlot = CastChecked<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Card->Slot))
1940 {
1941 CardSlot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(.5f, .5f));
1942 }
1943
1944 // 펼친 스킬 카드의 아이콘 정중앙에
1945 // 남은 쿨타임을 보여 준다. 기존 우하단 배지는 총 쿨타임처럼
1946 // 읽히므로 런타임에서 숨기고 이 겹만 사용한다.
1947 if (Index > 0)
1948 {
1949 UImage* CommandIcon = Cast<UImage>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
1950 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("CommandIcon_%d"), Index))));
1951 const UCanvasPanelSlot* IconSlot = CommandIcon != nullptr
1952 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(CommandIcon->Slot) : nullptr;
1953 if (IconSlot != nullptr)
1954 {
1955 UOverlay* CooldownRoot = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint,
1956 FName(*FString::Printf(
1957 TEXT("CommandCooldownOverlayRoot_%d"), Index)));
1958 PlaceCanvas(Card, CooldownRoot, IconSlot->GetPosition(),
1959 IconSlot->GetSize(), 40);
1960 CooldownRoot->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
1961
1962 UTextBlock* CooldownText = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint,
1963 FName(*FString::Printf(
1964 TEXT("CommandCooldownOverlay_%d"), Index)));
1965 EnsureParent(CooldownRoot, CooldownText);
1966 SetOverlayLayout(CooldownText, FMargin(0.f),
1967 HAlign_Center, VAlign_Center);
1968 FSlateFontInfo CooldownFont = UIFont::MakeProjectExact(
1969 CooldownText->GetFont(), 42);
1970 CooldownFont.OutlineSettings.OutlineSize = 4;
1971 CooldownFont.OutlineSettings.OutlineColor = FLinearColor::Black;
1972 CooldownText->SetFont(CooldownFont);
1973 CooldownText->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
1974 CooldownText->SetColorAndOpacity(
1975 FSlateColor(FLinearColor::White));
1976 CooldownText->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
1977 }
1978 }
1979
1980 // 크기 실험에서 추가한 바깥 래퍼는 남겨 두지 않는다. 카드 자체의
1981 // 200x228 저작 슬롯만 존재해야 해상도/DPI가 한 번만 적용된다.
1982 for (const FName RetiredName : {
1983 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("CommandCardScale_%d"), Index)),
1984 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("CommandCardDesignSize_%d"), Index)) })
1985 {
1986 if (UWidget* Retired = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(RetiredName))
1987 {
1988 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RemoveWidget(Retired);
1989 Blueprint->WidgetVariableNameToGuidMap.Remove(RetiredName);
1990 Blueprint->OnVariableRemoved(RetiredName);
1991 }
1992 }
1993 }
1994
1995 }

1997 void BuildEnemySummary(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, const FSlateFontInfo& BaseFont,
1998 UTexture2D* PanelTexture, UTexture2D* PortraitFrameTexture,
1999 UTexture2D* StatusFrameTexture, UTexture2D* SpeedTexture)
2000 {
2001 UCanvasPanel* Root = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget);
2002 UCanvasPanel* Panel = FindOrCreate<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyPanel"));
2003 PlaceCanvas(Root, Panel, FVector2D(-630.f, 178.f), FVector2D(600.f, 430.f), 60);
2004 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* PanelSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Panel->Slot))
2005 {
2006 PanelSlot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(1.f, 0.f));
2007 }
2008 Panel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2009
2010 UImage* Plate = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyPlate"));
2011 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Plate, FVector2D::ZeroVector, FVector2D(600.f, 430.f), 0);
2012 Plate->SetBrushFromTexture(PanelTexture, false);
2013 Plate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2014
2015 UImage* PortraitFrame = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyPortraitFrame"));
2016 PlaceCanvas(Panel, PortraitFrame, FVector2D(38.f, 34.f), FVector2D(126.f, 126.f), 5);
2017 PortraitFrame->SetBrushFromTexture(PortraitFrameTexture, false);
2018 PortraitFrame->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2019
2020 UImage* Portrait = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyPortrait"));
2021 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Portrait, FVector2D(51.f, 47.f), FVector2D(100.f, 100.f), 6);
2022 Portrait->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::ClipToBoundsAlways);
2023 Portrait->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2024
2025 UBorder* BadgePlate = FindOrCreate<UBorder>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyBadgePlate"));
2026 PlaceCanvas(Panel, BadgePlate, FVector2D(180.f, 45.f), FVector2D(62.f, 42.f), 6);
2027 BadgePlate->SetBrushColor(FLinearColor(.68f, .07f, .035f, .96f));
2028 BadgePlate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2029
2030 UTextBlock* Badge = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyBadgeText"));
2031 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Badge, FVector2D(180.f, 46.f), FVector2D(62.f, 40.f), 7);
2032 Badge->SetText(NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "EnemyBadge", "적"));
2033 SetReadableFont(Badge, BaseFont, 24);
2034
2035 UTextBlock* Name = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyName"));
2036 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Name, FVector2D(254.f, 37.f), FVector2D(300.f, 62.f), 7);
2037 Name->SetText(NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "EnemyNamePreview", "독수리"));
2038 SetReadableFont(Name, BaseFont, 38);
2039 Name->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Left);

2251 void BuildMercenaryInventoryTab(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, UCanvasPanel* Board,
2252 const FSlateFontInfo& BaseFont, UTexture2D* InventoryIconTexture,
2253 UTexture2D* GoldIconTexture, UTexture2D* DescriptionPlateTexture,
2254 UTexture2D* ArtifactSlotTexture)
2255 {
2256 /*
2257 * 3인 로스터 바로 아래의 파티 공용 인벤토리 탭.
2258 *
2259 * 런타임에서 ConstructWidget으로 덧붙이지 않는다. 판·아이콘·문구·입력면을
2260 * 전부 WBP에 구워 두어 디자이너에서 위치와 크기, 그림을 직접 바꿀 수 있게
2261 * 한다. C++은 이름으로 버튼을 찾아 의도만 연결한다.
2262 */
2263 UCanvasPanel* Roster = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
2264 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercRosterSection")));
2265 UWidget* SecondCard = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2266 TEXT("MercenaryCardScale_1"));
2267 UWidget* ThirdCard = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2268 TEXT("MercenaryCardScale_2"));
2269 UImage* ThirdPlate = Cast<UImage>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2270 TEXT("PartyPlate_2")));
2271 UCanvasPanelSlot* SecondSlot = SecondCard != nullptr
2272 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(SecondCard->Slot) : nullptr;
2273 UCanvasPanelSlot* ThirdSlot = ThirdCard != nullptr
2274 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ThirdCard->Slot) : nullptr;
2275 UCanvasPanelSlot* ThirdPlateSlot = ThirdPlate != nullptr
2276 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ThirdPlate->Slot) : nullptr;
2277 if (Roster == nullptr || SecondSlot == nullptr || ThirdSlot == nullptr
2278 || ThirdPlateSlot == nullptr)
2279 {
2280 // 통합 HUD에는 카드가 nested WBP 인스턴스로 들어가 슬롯을 직접
2281 // 고칠 수 없지만, 인벤토리 판/버튼의 직렬화된 프록시는 남아 있다.
2282 // 그 경우에도 실제 화면에서 보이는 크기 차이는 이 프록시에서 바로
2283 // 보정한다. 독립 WBP는 아래 정상 경로에서 전체를 재구성한다.
2284 UImage* ExistingInventoryPlate = Cast<UImage>(
2285 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabPlate")));
2286 UButton* ExistingInventoryButton = Cast<UButton>(
2287 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryButton")));
2288 UImage* ExistingPartyPlate = Cast<UImage>(
2289 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("PartyPlate_2")));
2290 UCanvasPanelSlot* ExistingPlateSlot = ExistingInventoryPlate != nullptr
2291 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingInventoryPlate->Slot) : nullptr;
2292 UCanvasPanelSlot* ExistingButtonSlot = ExistingInventoryButton != nullptr
2293 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingInventoryButton->Slot) : nullptr;
2294 UCanvasPanelSlot* ExistingPartySlot = ExistingPartyPlate != nullptr
2295 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingPartyPlate->Slot) : nullptr;
2296 if (ExistingPlateSlot != nullptr && ExistingButtonSlot != nullptr)
2297 {
2298 const FVector2D DonorSize = ExistingPartySlot != nullptr
2299 ? ExistingPartySlot->GetSize() : FVector2D(350.f, 128.f);
2300 const FVector2D VisibleSize(DonorSize.X * 1.075f, DonorSize.Y * .95f);
2301 const FVector2D VisiblePosition(0.f, (DonorSize.Y - VisibleSize.Y) * .5f);
2302 ExistingPlateSlot->SetPosition(VisiblePosition);
2303 ExistingPlateSlot->SetSize(VisibleSize);
2304 ExistingButtonSlot->SetPosition(VisiblePosition);
2305 ExistingButtonSlot->SetSize(VisibleSize);
2306 if (UCanvasPanel* Parent = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
2307 ExistingInventoryPlate->GetParent()))
2308 {
2309 Parent->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::Inherit);
2310 UImage* ExistingIcon = Cast<UImage>(
2311 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2312 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabIcon")));
2313 UTextBlock* ExistingLabel = Cast<UTextBlock>(
2314 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2315 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabText")));
2316 if (ExistingIcon != nullptr && ExistingLabel != nullptr)
2317 {
2318 // 통합 HUD에 남은 직렬화 프록시도 독립 용병 WBP와 같은
2319 // 구조로 만든다. 문구만 판 중앙에 두면 가방이 왼쪽에
2320 // 추가되어 두 요소 전체가 오른쪽으로 치우쳐 보인다.
2321 UOverlay* Center = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(Blueprint,
2322 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabText_Center"));
2323 PlaceCanvas(Parent, Center, VisiblePosition, VisibleSize, 2);
2324 UHorizontalBox* Content = FindOrCreate<UHorizontalBox>(Blueprint,
2325 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabContent"));
2326 EnsureParent(Center, Content);
2327 SetOverlayLayout(Content, FMargin(0.f), HAlign_Center,
2328 VAlign_Center);
2329 USizeBox* IconSizeBox = FindOrCreate<USizeBox>(Blueprint,
2330 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabIconSize"));
2331 const float CardScaleX = DonorSize.X / 350.f;
2332 const float CardScaleY = DonorSize.Y / 128.f;
2333 const float IconSize = FMath::Min(
2334 96.f * CardScaleX, 96.f * CardScaleY);
2335 IconSizeBox->SetWidthOverride(IconSize);
2336 IconSizeBox->SetHeightOverride(IconSize);
2337 EnsureParent(IconSizeBox, ExistingIcon);
2338 EnsureParent(Content, IconSizeBox);
2339 if (UHorizontalBoxSlot* IconSlot =
2340 Cast<UHorizontalBoxSlot>(IconSizeBox->Slot))
2341 {
2342 IconSlot->SetPadding(FMargin(
2343 0.f, 0.f, 12.f * CardScaleX, 0.f));
2344 IconSlot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Center);
2345 IconSlot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
2346 }
2347 EnsureParent(Content, ExistingLabel);
2348 if (UHorizontalBoxSlot* LabelSlot =
2349 Cast<UHorizontalBoxSlot>(ExistingLabel->Slot))
2350 {
2351 LabelSlot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f));
2352 LabelSlot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Left);
2353 LabelSlot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
2354 }
2355 ExistingLabel->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Left);
2356 ExistingLabel->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
2357 }
2358 }
2359 UWidget* ExistingGoldFrame = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2360 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryGoldFrame"));
2361 UImage* ExistingGoldIcon = Cast<UImage>(
2362 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryGoldIcon")));
2363 UCanvasPanelSlot* GoldFrameSlot = ExistingGoldFrame != nullptr
2364 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingGoldFrame->Slot) : nullptr;
2365 UCanvasPanelSlot* GoldIconSlot = ExistingGoldIcon != nullptr
2366 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingGoldIcon->Slot) : nullptr;
2367 UCanvasPanel* GoldParent = ExistingGoldFrame != nullptr
2368 ? Cast<UCanvasPanel>(ExistingGoldFrame->GetParent()) : nullptr;
2369 if (GoldFrameSlot != nullptr && GoldIconSlot != nullptr
2370 && GoldParent != nullptr)
2371 {
2372 const FVector2D FramePosition = GoldFrameSlot->GetPosition();
2373 const FVector2D FrameSize = GoldFrameSlot->GetSize();
2374 const float IconSize = FMath::Min(FrameSize.X, FrameSize.Y) * .38f;
2375 PlaceCanvas(GoldParent, ExistingGoldIcon,
2376 FramePosition + (FrameSize - FVector2D(IconSize, IconSize)) * .5f,
2377 FVector2D(IconSize, IconSize), 3);
2378 }
2379 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Display,
2380 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD repaired nested proxy size=%s"),
2381 *VisibleSize.ToString());
2382 }
2383 else
2384 {
2385 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error,
2386 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD missing roster/proxy slots"));
2387 }
2388 return;
2389 }
2390 // 인벤토리 전용 재빌드도 세 로스터 행의 좌상단 앵커 계약을 복구한다.
2391 // 현재 자산은 Roster 자체가 Board (210,246)에 놓이고 카드는 그 안의
2392 // 로컬 좌표를 쓴다. 옛 자산처럼 Roster가 (0,0)인 경우도 있으므로
2393 // Board 절대 좌표에서 Roster 원점을 빼 두 구조를 모두 같은 화면에 둔다.
2394 UCanvasPanelSlot* RosterSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Roster->Slot);
2395 if (RosterSlot != nullptr)
2396 {
2397 RosterSlot->SetPosition(FVector2D(240.f, 0.f));
2398 RosterSlot->SetSize(FVector2D(1680.f, 1080.f));
2399 }
2400 const FVector2D RosterOrigin = RosterSlot != nullptr
2401 ? RosterSlot->GetPosition() : FVector2D::ZeroVector;
2402 const FVector2D AuthoredBoardCardPositions[] = {
2403 FVector2D(490.f, 280.f), FVector2D(490.f, 416.f), FVector2D(490.f, 552.f)
2404 };
2405 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < UE_ARRAY_COUNT(AuthoredBoardCardPositions); ++Index)
2406 {
2407 if (UWidget* RosterCard = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2408 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryCardScale_%d"), Index))))
2409 {
2410 if (UScaleBox* RosterScale = Cast<UScaleBox>(RosterCard))
2411 {
2412 // 세 카드와 네 번째 탭이 같은 외곽 슬롯을 100% 채우게 한다.
2413 // ScaleToFit은 350:128과 390:142의 0.5% 비율차 때문에 좌우에
2414 // 서로 다른 빈 폭을 남겨 실기에서 버튼 크기가 달라 보였다.
2415 RosterScale->SetStretch(EStretch::Fill);
2416 }
2417 const UCanvasPanelSlot* ExistingSlot =
2418 Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(RosterCard->Slot);
2419 // Donor WBP의 실제 저장 크기를 보존한다. 화면에서 보이는 용병
2420 // 카드가 계약값과 다르면 상수로 덮는 순간 네 번째 탭과 어긋난다.
2421 const FVector2D Size = ExistingSlot != nullptr
2422 ? ExistingSlot->GetSize() : FVector2D(390.f, 142.f);
2423 const int32 ZOrder = ExistingSlot != nullptr
2424 ? ExistingSlot->GetZOrder() : 3;
2425 PlaceCanvas(Roster, RosterCard,
2426 AuthoredBoardCardPositions[Index] - RosterOrigin, Size, ZOrder);
2427 }
2428 }
2429 const FVector2D RowStep = ThirdSlot->GetPosition() - SecondSlot->GetPosition();
2430 const FVector2D TabPosition = ThirdSlot->GetPosition() + RowStep;
2431 // 수치 계약이 아니라 바로 위 세 번째 용병 카드와 내부 판을 donor로 쓴다.
2432 // 따라서 디자이너가 용병 카드 크기를 바꿔도 인벤토리는 같은 프레임에서
2433 // 같은 픽셀 크기를 복제한다.
2434 const FVector2D TabSize = ThirdSlot->GetSize();
2435 const FVector2D LocalTabSize = ThirdPlateSlot->GetSize();
2436 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Display,
2437 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_DONOR outer=%s plate=%s third=%s"),
2438 *TabSize.ToString(), *LocalTabSize.ToString(), *ThirdCard->GetName());
2439
2440 // 세 용병 카드와 똑같이 ScaleBox -> 로컬 카드 Canvas 구조를 쓴다.
2441 // 직접 작은 Canvas를 붙이면 같은 에셋이어도 네 번째만 작게 보인다.
2442 UScaleBox* InventoryScale = FindOrCreate<UScaleBox>(
2443 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryScale"));
2444 PlaceCanvas(Roster, InventoryScale, TabPosition, TabSize, 4);
2445 if (const UScaleBox* ThirdScale = Cast<UScaleBox>(ThirdCard))
2446 {
2447 InventoryScale->SetStretch(ThirdScale->GetStretch());
2448 InventoryScale->SetStretchDirection(ThirdScale->GetStretchDirection());
2449 InventoryScale->SetUserSpecifiedScale(ThirdScale->GetUserSpecifiedScale());
2450 InventoryScale->SetIgnoreInheritedScale(
2451 ThirdScale->IsIgnoreInheritedScale());
2452 }
2453 InventoryScale->SetStretch(EStretch::Fill);
2454 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* InventoryScaleSlot =
2455 Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(InventoryScale->Slot))
2456 {
2457 InventoryScaleSlot->SetAnchors(ThirdSlot->GetAnchors());
2458 InventoryScaleSlot->SetAlignment(ThirdSlot->GetAlignment());
2459 }
2460 UCanvasPanel* InventoryTab = FindOrCreate<UCanvasPanel>(
2461 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTab"));
2462 EnsureParent(InventoryScale, InventoryTab);
2463 // 보정된 donor 외곽선이 Canvas의 350px desired width에서 잘리지 않게 한다.
2464 // 실제 입력면은 아래 VisibleTabSize로 명시되어 로스터 밖을 받지 않는다.
2465 InventoryTab->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::Inherit);
2466
2467 UImage* InventoryPlate = FindOrCreate<UImage>(
2468 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabPlate"));
2469 // donor 카드에는 레벨 배지/HP 자식들이 Canvas의 desired geometry를
2470 // 가로로 넓혀 주지만 인벤토리에는 그 자식이 없다. 같은 350x128 슬롯을
2471 // 복사해도 실제 Slate 결과가 6% 좁고 8% 높게 나왔다. 실물 캡처에서 잰
2472 // donor의 보이는 프레임 비율로 보정해 외곽선을 픽셀 단위로 맞춘다.
2473 const FVector2D VisibleTabSize(LocalTabSize.X * 1.075f, LocalTabSize.Y * .95f);
2474 const FVector2D VisibleTabPosition(0.f, (LocalTabSize.Y - VisibleTabSize.Y) * .5f);
2475 PlaceCanvas(InventoryTab, InventoryPlate, VisibleTabPosition,
2476 VisibleTabSize, 1);
2477 InventoryPlate->SetBrush(ThirdPlate->GetBrush());
2478 InventoryPlate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2479
2480 UImage* InventoryIcon = FindOrCreate<UImage>(
2481 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabIcon"));
2482 // 네 번째 줄도 용병 카드의 초상화 칸을 그대로 쓴다. 별도 수치로
2483 // 줄이면 같은 프레임인데도 인벤토리만 다른 규격처럼 보인다.
2484 const float CardScaleX = LocalTabSize.X / 350.f;
2485 const float CardScaleY = LocalTabSize.Y / 128.f;
2486 const float IconSize = FMath::Min(96.f * CardScaleX, 96.f * CardScaleY);
2487 InventoryIcon->SetBrushFromTexture(InventoryIconTexture, false);
2488 InventoryIcon->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2489
2490 UTextBlock* InventoryLabel = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(
2491 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabText"));
2492 // 아이콘과 문구를 따로 판 중앙에 맞추면 둘을 합친 덩어리는 왼쪽으로
2493 // 치우친다. 둘을 하나의 가로 행으로 묶고 그 행 자체를 판 중앙에 둔다.
2494 UOverlay* InventoryLabelCenter = FindOrCreate<UOverlay>(
2495 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabText_Center"));
2496 PlaceCanvas(InventoryTab, InventoryLabelCenter, VisibleTabPosition,
2497 VisibleTabSize, 2);
2498 UHorizontalBox* InventoryContent = FindOrCreate<UHorizontalBox>(
2499 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabContent"));
2500 EnsureParent(InventoryLabelCenter, InventoryContent);
2501 SetOverlayLayout(InventoryContent, FMargin(0.f), HAlign_Center, VAlign_Center);
2502 USizeBox* InventoryIconSize = FindOrCreate<USizeBox>(
2503 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTabIconSize"));
2504 InventoryIconSize->SetWidthOverride(IconSize);
2505 InventoryIconSize->SetHeightOverride(IconSize);
2506 EnsureParent(InventoryIconSize, InventoryIcon);
2507 EnsureParent(InventoryContent, InventoryIconSize);
2508 if (UHorizontalBoxSlot* IconSlot = Cast<UHorizontalBoxSlot>(
2509 InventoryIconSize->Slot))
2510 {
2511 IconSlot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f, 0.f, 12.f * CardScaleX, 0.f));
2512 IconSlot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Center);
2513 IconSlot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
2514 }
2515 EnsureParent(InventoryContent, InventoryLabel);
2516 if (UHorizontalBoxSlot* LabelSlot = Cast<UHorizontalBoxSlot>(
2517 InventoryLabel->Slot))
2518 {
2519 LabelSlot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f));
2520 LabelSlot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Left);
2521 LabelSlot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Center);
2522 }
2523 InventoryLabel->SetText(NSLOCTEXT(
2524 "CombatHUD", "MercenaryInventoryTab", "인벤토리"));
2525 SetReadableFont(InventoryLabel, BaseFont, 27);
2526 InventoryLabel->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Left);
2527 InventoryLabel->SetRenderTransform(FWidgetTransform());
2528
2529 UButton* InventoryButton = FindOrCreate<UButton>(
2530 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryButton"));
2531 PlaceCanvas(InventoryTab, InventoryButton, VisibleTabPosition,
2532 VisibleTabSize, 10);
2533 SetInvisibleButtonChrome(InventoryButton);
2534
2535 // 오른쪽 용병 상세 자리를 그대로 쓰는 인벤토리 페이지. 왼쪽 네 줄은
2536 // 유지되어 언제든 용병 상세로 돌아갈 수 있다.
2537 // MercDetailSection은 상세 부품을 묶은 전면 Canvas라 슬롯 자체는
2538 // 1920x1080이다. 그 크기를 복사하면 인벤토리가 새 화면처럼 왼쪽 탭까지
2539 // 덮는다. 같은 용병판의 오른쪽 내용 영역만 쓰도록 명시한다.
2540 // 1672x941 실물 캡처에서 외곽 셸의 검은 내용면을 재서 잡은 영역이다.
2541 // 헤더 금속 테두리와 아래 닫기 레일을 피하고 오른쪽 내용면 안에만 둔다.
2542 const FVector2D PagePosition(560.f, 194.f);
2543 // 실기 캡처에서 600 높이는 4x2 격자를 상단에 몰아 하단 검은 면이
2544 // 과하게 남았다. 셸의 실제 내부 하단까지 사용해 두 줄을 세로 중앙에 둔다.
2545 const FVector2D PageSize(1240.f, 610.f);
2546 UCanvasPanel* Page = FindOrCreate<UCanvasPanel>(
2547 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryPage"));
2548 PlaceCanvas(Board, Page, PagePosition, PageSize, 30);
2549 Page->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::ClipToBoundsAlways);
2550 Page->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2551
2552 UBorder* Backdrop = FindOrCreate<UBorder>(
2553 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryPageBackdrop"));
2554 PlaceCanvas(Page, Backdrop, FVector2D::ZeroVector, PageSize, 0);
2555 // 상세 묶음 자체를 접으므로 별도 단색 덮개가 필요 없다. 덮개 색이 셸과
2556 // 조금만 달라도 새 팝업처럼 네모 경계가 생긴다. 위젯은 WBP 편집용으로
2557 // 남기되 기본값만 접어 기존 용병 셸의 오른쪽 면을 그대로 쓴다.
2558 Backdrop->SetBrushColor(FLinearColor::Transparent);
2559 Backdrop->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2560
2561 UTextBlock* Title = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(
2562 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryTitle"));
2563 PlaceCanvas(Page, Title, FVector2D(250.f, 10.f),
2564 FVector2D(710.f, 72.f), 2);
2565 Title->SetText(NSLOCTEXT(
2566 "CombatHUD", "MercenaryInventoryTitle", "보유 아티팩트"));
2567 SetReadableFont(Title, BaseFont, 38);
2568 Title->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
2569 Title->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2570
2571 UTextBlock* GoldLabel = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(
2572 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryGoldLabel"));
2573 PlaceCanvas(Page, GoldLabel, FVector2D(980.f, 22.f), FVector2D(80.f, 54.f), 2);
2574 GoldLabel->SetText(NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "MercenaryInventoryGold", "골드"));
2575 SetReadableFont(GoldLabel, BaseFont, 28);
2576 // 시안은 숫자 옆 실제 골드 아이콘만 쓴다. 라벨은 WBP에서 다시 켤 수
2577 // 있도록 삭제하지 않고 기본값만 접어 둔다.
2578 GoldLabel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2579 UImage* GoldIcon = FindOrCreate<UImage>(
2580 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryGoldIcon"));
2581 // 슬롯 그림의 실물 내부는 전체 텍스처의 약 69%뿐이다
2582 // (UIPartRects::Inner 계약). 페이지 폭에 끝점만 맞춰 균등분배하면 투명
2583 // 외곽까지 간격으로 계산되어, 화면에서는 작은 칸들이 멀리 흩어져 보인다.
2584 // 그래서 프레임 자체를 키우고 그림의 가시 경계끼리 약 30px만 남는 고정
2585 // 피치를 쓴다. 4x2 전체가 오른쪽 검은 내용면 중앙에 한 덩어리로 놓인다.
2586 constexpr float FrameSize = 210.f;
2587 constexpr float ColumnGap = 24.f;
2588 constexpr float RowGap = 30.f;
2589 constexpr float ColumnPitch = FrameSize + ColumnGap;
2590 constexpr float RowPitch = FrameSize + RowGap;
2591 constexpr float GridWidth = FrameSize * 4.f + ColumnGap * 3.f;
2592 constexpr float GridHeight = FrameSize * 2.f + RowGap;
2593 // 왼쪽의 용병/인벤토리 탭 묶음은 오른쪽으로 옮겼지만, 오른쪽 내용면의
2594 // 슬롯은 반대로 왼쪽으로 당겨 프레임 안에서 시각 중심을 맞춘다.
2595 constexpr float GridShiftRight = -154.f;
2596 const FVector2D GridOrigin(
2597 (PageSize.X - GridWidth) * .5f + GridShiftRight,
2598 (PageSize.Y - GridHeight) * .5f);
2599 UImage* GoldFrame = FindOrCreate<UImage>(
2600 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryGoldFrame"));
2601 PlaceCanvas(Page, GoldFrame, GridOrigin, FVector2D(FrameSize, FrameSize), 2);
2602 GoldFrame->SetBrushFromTexture(ArtifactSlotTexture, false);
2603 GoldFrame->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2604 const FBox2D GoldInner = UIPartRects::Inner(TEXT("T_MB_ArtifactSlot_Frame"),
2605 GridOrigin, FVector2D(FrameSize, FrameSize), false);
2606 const FVector2D GoldContentSize = GoldInner.GetSize();
2607 const float GoldIconSize = FMath::Min(GoldContentSize.X,
2608 GoldContentSize.Y) * .55f;
2609 PlaceCanvas(Page, GoldIcon,
2610 FVector2D(GridOrigin.X + (FrameSize - GoldIconSize) * .5f,
2611 GridOrigin.Y + (FrameSize - GoldIconSize) * .5f),
2612 FVector2D(GoldIconSize, GoldIconSize), 3);
2613 GoldIcon->SetBrushFromTexture(GoldIconTexture, false);
2614 GoldIcon->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2615 UTextBlock* GoldText = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(
2616 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryGoldText"));
2617 // TextBlock의 글꼴 베이스라인이 슬롯 아래로 내려가므로 숫자 칸을
2618 // 프레임의 하단 경계에서 충분히 올린다. 실제 2176x1812 캡처에서
2619 // "100"이 프레임 밖으로 빠진 원인이었다.
2620 PlaceCanvas(Page, GoldText,
2621 FVector2D(GoldInner.Min.X + GoldContentSize.X * .48f,
2622 GoldInner.Min.Y + GoldContentSize.Y * .70f),
2623 FVector2D(GoldContentSize.X * .47f, GoldContentSize.Y * .24f), 4);
2624 GoldText->SetText(FText::AsNumber(100));
2625 SetReadableFont(GoldText, BaseFont, 24);
2626 GoldText->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
2627 static const TCHAR* const PreviewArtifactPaths[6] = {
2628 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Artifacts/T_Artifact_BloodChalice.T_Artifact_BloodChalice"),
2629 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Artifacts/T_Artifact_FangAmulet.T_Artifact_FangAmulet"),
2630 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Artifacts/T_Artifact_LuckyCoin.T_Artifact_LuckyCoin"),
2631 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Artifacts/T_Artifact_ThornCrest.T_Artifact_ThornCrest"),
2632 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Artifacts/T_Artifact_TravelersMap.T_Artifact_TravelersMap"),
2633 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Artifacts/T_Artifact_WornShieldOrnament.T_Artifact_WornShieldOrnament") };
2634 static const FText PreviewArtifactNames[6] = {
2635 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ArtifactPreviewChalice", "피의 성배"),
2636 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ArtifactPreviewFang", "야수의 송곳니"),
2637 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ArtifactPreviewCoin", "행운의 주화"),
2638 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ArtifactPreviewThorn", "가시 문장"),
2639 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ArtifactPreviewMap", "여행자의 지도"),
2640 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ArtifactPreviewShield", "낡은 방패 장식") };
2641 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 7; ++Index)
2642 {
2643 const int32 VisualIndex = Index + 1;
2644 const int32 Column = VisualIndex % 4;
2645 const int32 Row = VisualIndex / 4;
2646 const FVector2D CellOrigin = GridOrigin + FVector2D(
2647 Column * ColumnPitch, Row * RowPitch);
2648
2649 // 조회 전용 격자라 선택 테두리를 두지 않는다. 터치하면 별도 상세가 뜬다.
2650 if (UWidget* Selection = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2651 FName(*FString::Printf(
2652 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactSelection_%d"), Index))))
2653 {
2654 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RemoveWidget(Selection);
2655 }
2656
2657 UImage* Frame = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
2658 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactFrame_%d"), Index)));
2659 PlaceCanvas(Page, Frame, CellOrigin, FVector2D(FrameSize, FrameSize), 2);
2660 Frame->SetBrushFromTexture(ArtifactSlotTexture, false);
2661 Frame->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2662
2663 UImage* Icon = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
2664 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactIcon_%d"), Index)));
2665 const FBox2D CellInner = UIPartRects::Inner(
2666 TEXT("T_MB_ArtifactSlot_Frame"), CellOrigin,
2667 FVector2D(FrameSize, FrameSize), false);
2668 const float ArtifactIconSize = FMath::Min(
2669 CellInner.GetSize().X, CellInner.GetSize().Y) * .82f;
2670 PlaceCanvas(Page, Icon,
2671 CellInner.GetCenter() - FVector2D(ArtifactIconSize * .5f),
2672 FVector2D(ArtifactIconSize, ArtifactIconSize), 3);
2673 if (Index < 6)
2674 {
2675 if (UTexture2D* PreviewArtifact = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(
2676 nullptr, PreviewArtifactPaths[Index]))
2677 {
2678 Icon->SetBrushFromTexture(PreviewArtifact, false);
2679 }
2680 }
2681 Icon->SetVisibility(Index < 6
2682 ? ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible
2683 : ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2684
2685 UTextBlock* Name = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint,
2686 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactName_%d"), Index)));
2687 PlaceCanvas(Page, Name, CellOrigin + FVector2D(-24.f, FrameSize + 3.f),
2688 FVector2D(FrameSize + 48.f, 34.f), 4);
2689 Name->SetText(Index < 6
2690 ? FText(PreviewArtifactNames[Index])
2691 : FText::GetEmpty());
2692 SetReadableFont(Name, BaseFont, 17);
2693 Name->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
2694 // 슬롯 이름은 디자이너가 필요할 때 WBP에서 켠다. 런타임은 텍스트만
2695 // 갱신하고 Visibility를 덮어쓰지 않는다.
2696 Name->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2697
2698 UButton* Button = FindOrCreate<UButton>(Blueprint,
2699 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactButton_%d"), Index)));
2700 PlaceCanvas(Page, Button, CellOrigin, FVector2D(FrameSize, FrameSize), 5);
2701 SetInvisibleButtonChrome(Button);
2702 }
2703 // 확정 4x2(골드 1 + 아티팩트 7) 밖에 남은 옛 칸을 걷는다.
2704 for (const TCHAR* Prefix : { TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactSelection"),
2705 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactFrame"), TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactIcon"),
2706 TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactName"), TEXT("MercenaryInventoryArtifactButton") })
2707 {
2708 for (int32 Index = 7; Index < 16; ++Index)
2709 {
2710 if (UWidget* Stale = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2711 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%s_%d"), Prefix, Index))))
2712 {
2713 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RemoveWidget(Stale);
2714 }
2715 }
2716 }
2717
2718 UImage* DescriptionPlate = FindOrCreate<UImage>(
2719 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryDescriptionPlate"));
2720 PlaceCanvas(Page, DescriptionPlate, FVector2D(65.f, 585.f),
2721 FVector2D(1080.f, 72.f), 2);
2722 DescriptionPlate->SetBrushFromTexture(DescriptionPlateTexture, false);
2723 DescriptionPlate->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2724
2725 UTextBlock* Description = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(
2726 Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryInventoryDescriptionText"));
2727 PlaceCanvas(Page, Description, FVector2D(135.f, 596.f),
2728 FVector2D(940.f, 50.f), 3);
2729 Description->SetText(NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "MercenaryInventoryPreview",
2730 "피의 성배 — 처치 시 체력을 5 회복한다."));
2731 SetReadableFont(Description, BaseFont, 20);
2732 Description->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Center);
2733 Description->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2734 }
2735
2736 void BuildEnemyAPPips(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
2737 {
2738 UCanvasPanel* EnemyPanel = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
2739 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("EnemyPanel")));
2740 UImage* TemplatePip = Cast<UImage>(
2741 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("TurnAPPip_0")));
2742 UImage* EmptyTemplatePip = Cast<UImage>(
2743 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("TurnAPPipUsed_0")));
2744 UWidget* Anchor = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("EnemyCritPlate"));
2745 UCanvasPanelSlot* AnchorSlot = Anchor != nullptr
2746 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Anchor->Slot) : nullptr;
2747 UCanvasPanel* ExistingRow = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
2748 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("EnemyAPPipRow")));
2749 UCanvasPanelSlot* ExistingRowSlot = ExistingRow != nullptr
2750 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(ExistingRow->Slot) : nullptr;
2751 if (EnemyPanel == nullptr || TemplatePip == nullptr
2752 || EmptyTemplatePip == nullptr
2753 || (ExistingRowSlot == nullptr && AnchorSlot == nullptr))
2754 {
2755 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error,
2756 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD missing enemy AP anchor"));
2757 return;
2758 }
2759 // 디자이너에서 옮긴 행 위치는 보존한다. 칸 구성만 30x30 열 칸으로 고친다.
2760 const FVector2D RowPosition = ExistingRowSlot != nullptr
2761 ? ExistingRowSlot->GetPosition() : AnchorSlot->GetPosition();
2762 constexpr int32 PipCount = 10;
2763 constexpr float PipSize = 30.f;
2764 constexpr float PipGap = 4.f;
2765 const FVector2D RowSize(
2766 PipCount * PipSize + (PipCount - 1) * PipGap, PipSize);
2767 // 세로 요약판은 AP 문구와 상태이상만 쓴다. 치명타 칸은 옛 AP 보석
2768 // 행의 위치를 읽기 위한 앵커일 뿐이며, 인벤토리 재빌드가 다시 켜면 안 된다.
2769 for (const TCHAR* CriticalWidget : {
2770 TEXT("EnemyCritPlate"), TEXT("EnemyCritIcon"), TEXT("EnemyCritText") })
2771 {
2772 if (UWidget* Widget = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2773 FName(CriticalWidget)))
2774 {
2775 Widget->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2776 }
2777 }
2778 // WBP 자체를 열거나 오프스크린으로 찍을 때도 아래 미리보기 적(4 AP)과
2779 // 숫자가 어긋나지 않게 한다. 실게임에서는 RefreshEnemy가 같은
2780 // FUnitUI::mActionPoints 값으로 이 문구와 보석을 함께 갱신한다.
2781 if (UTextBlock* APText = Cast<UTextBlock>(
2782 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("EnemyAPText"))))
2783 {
2784 APText->SetText(FText::FromString(TEXT("AP 4/4")));
2785 }
2786
2787 UCanvasPanel* Row = FindOrCreate<UCanvasPanel>(
2788 Blueprint, TEXT("EnemyAPPipRow"));
2789 PlaceCanvas(EnemyPanel, Row, RowPosition, RowSize, 15);
2790 // 0822 확정: 요약판 AP 보석 행도 걷는다. 이름 계약만 남긴다.
2791 Row->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2792 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < PipCount; ++Index)
2793 {
2794 const FVector2D PipPosition(Index * (PipSize + PipGap), 0.f);
2795 UImage* UsedPip = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
2796 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("EnemyAPPipUsed_%d"), Index)));
2797 PlaceCanvas(Row, UsedPip, PipPosition,
2798 FVector2D(PipSize, PipSize), 0);
2799 UsedPip->SetBrush(EmptyTemplatePip->GetBrush());
2800 UsedPip->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2801
2802 UImage* Pip = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint,
2803 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("EnemyAPPip_%d"), Index)));
2804 PlaceCanvas(Row, Pip, PipPosition,
2805 FVector2D(PipSize, PipSize), 1);
2806 Pip->SetBrush(TemplatePip->GetBrush());
2807 Pip->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
2808 }
2809 }

2811 bool SaveCompiledBlueprint(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
2812 {
2813 if (Blueprint == nullptr)
2814 {
2815 return false;
2816 }
2817 PruneStaleVariables(Blueprint);
2818 FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified(Blueprint);
2819 FKismetEditorUtilities::CompileBlueprint(Blueprint);
2820 return UPackage::SavePackage(Blueprint->GetPackage(), Blueprint,
2821 *FPackageName::LongPackageNameToFilename(
2822 Blueprint->GetOutermost()->GetName(),
2823 FPackageName::GetAssetPackageExtension()),
2824 FSavePackageArgs());
2825 }

2827 bool RepairMercenaryPortraitFrame(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint,
2828 UTexture2D* PortraitFrameTexture)
2829 {
2830 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr
2831 || PortraitFrameTexture == nullptr)
2832 {
2833 return false;
2834 }
2835 UImage* PortraitFrame = Cast<UImage>(
2836 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryPortraitFrame")));
2837 if (PortraitFrame == nullptr)
2838 {
2839 return false;
2840 }
2841 FSlateBrush Brush = PortraitFrame->GetBrush();
2842 Brush.SetResourceObject(PortraitFrameTexture);
2843 Brush.DrawAs = ESlateBrushDrawType::Image;
2844 Brush.Margin = FMargin(0.f);
2845 PortraitFrame->SetBrush(Brush);
2846 PortraitFrame->SetColorAndOpacity(FLinearColor::White);
2847 PortraitFrame->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
2848 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* FrameSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(PortraitFrame->Slot))
2849 {
2850 if (UWidget* Hero = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
2851 TEXT("MercenaryHeroPortrait")))
2852 {
2853 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* HeroSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Hero->Slot))
2854 {
2855 // T_KitA_Cell_Normal은 중앙까지 불투명하다. 초상화 위에 그리면
2856 // 얼굴을 가리므로 셀은 매트처럼 아래, 크롭된 초상화는 위에 둔다.
2857 FrameSlot->SetZOrder(HeroSlot->GetZOrder() - 1);
2858 Hero->SetClipping(EWidgetClipping::ClipToBoundsAlways);
2859 }
2860 }
2861 }
2862 return true;
2863 }
