2906 void BuildInventoryTabOnly()
2907 {
2908 UWidgetBlueprint* HudBlueprint =
2909 LoadObject<UWidgetBlueprint>(nullptr, AssetPath);
2910 UWidgetBlueprint* MercenaryBlueprint =
2911 LoadObject<UWidgetBlueprint>(nullptr, MercenaryAssetPath);
2912 UTexture2D* InventoryIconTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
2913 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/UI/KayKit/KK_Icon_Inventory.KK_Icon_Inventory"));
2914 UTexture2D* GoldIconTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
2915 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Reward/T_Reward_GoldIcon_V1.T_Reward_GoldIcon_V1"));
2916 UTexture2D* DescriptionPlateTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
2917 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Marchbound/KitA/T_KitA_Row_Plate.T_KitA_Row_Plate"));
2918 UTexture2D* ArtifactSlotTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
2919 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Marchbound/KitA/T_KitA_Cell_Normal.T_KitA_Cell_Normal"));
2920 UTexture2D* PortraitFrameTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
2921 DetailPortraitCellTexturePath);
2922 if (HudBlueprint == nullptr || MercenaryBlueprint == nullptr
2923 || InventoryIconTexture == nullptr || GoldIconTexture == nullptr
2924 || DescriptionPlateTexture == nullptr || ArtifactSlotTexture == nullptr
2925 || PortraitFrameTexture == nullptr)
2926 {
2927 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error,
2928 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD missing WBP or texture"));
2929 return;
2930 }
2931
2932 UTextBlock* RoundText = Cast<UTextBlock>(
2933 HudBlueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundText")));
2934 UCanvasPanel* InlineBoard = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
2935 HudBlueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryBoard")));
2936 UCanvasPanel* ModularBoard = Cast<UCanvasPanel>(
2937 MercenaryBlueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("MercenaryBoard")));
2938 if (RoundText == nullptr || InlineBoard == nullptr || ModularBoard == nullptr)
2939 {
2940 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error,
2941 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD missing authored board"));
2942 return;
2943 }
2944
2945 const FSlateFontInfo BaseFont = RoundText->GetFont();
2946 for (const TPair<UWidgetBlueprint*, UCanvasPanel*> Target : {
2947 TPair<UWidgetBlueprint*, UCanvasPanel*>(HudBlueprint, InlineBoard),
2948 TPair<UWidgetBlueprint*, UCanvasPanel*>(MercenaryBlueprint, ModularBoard) })
2949 {
2950 Target.Key->Modify();
2951 Target.Key->WidgetTree->Modify();
2952 BuildMercenaryInventoryTab(Target.Key, Target.Value, BaseFont,
2953 InventoryIconTexture, GoldIconTexture, DescriptionPlateTexture,
2954 ArtifactSlotTexture);
2955 // 이 전용 빌더로 갱신하는 기존 WBP에는 스킬 그림만 있고 입력 버튼이
2956 // 없을 수 있다. 다른 HUD 배치는 건드리지 않고 각 프레임 슬롯만 복제한다.
2957 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 6; ++Index)
2958 {
2959 UWidget* Frame = Target.Key->WidgetTree->FindWidget(FName(*FString::Printf(
2960 TEXT("MercenarySkillFrame_%d"), Index)));
2961 UCanvasPanel* SkillCanvasParent = Frame != nullptr
2962 ? Cast<UCanvasPanel>(Frame->GetParent()) : nullptr;
2963 UOverlay* SkillOverlayParent = Frame != nullptr
2964 ? Cast<UOverlay>(Frame->GetParent()) : nullptr;
2965 const UCanvasPanelSlot* FrameSlot = Frame != nullptr
2966 ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Frame->Slot) : nullptr;
2967 if (Frame == nullptr
2968 || (SkillCanvasParent == nullptr && SkillOverlayParent == nullptr))
2969 {
2970 continue;
2971 }
2972 UButton* Button = FindOrCreate<UButton>(Target.Key,
2973 FName(*FString::Printf(TEXT("MercenarySkillButton_%d"), Index)));
2974 if (SkillCanvasParent != nullptr && FrameSlot != nullptr)
2975 {
2976 PlaceCanvas(SkillCanvasParent, Button, FrameSlot->GetPosition(),
2977 FrameSlot->GetSize(), FrameSlot->GetZOrder() + 20);
2978 }
2979 else if (SkillOverlayParent != nullptr)
2980 {
2981 EnsureParent(SkillOverlayParent, Button);
2982 if (UOverlaySlot* ButtonSlot = Cast<UOverlaySlot>(Button->Slot))
2983 {
2984 ButtonSlot->SetPadding(FMargin(0.f));
2985 ButtonSlot->SetHorizontalAlignment(HAlign_Fill);
2986 ButtonSlot->SetVerticalAlignment(VAlign_Fill);
2987 }
2988 }
2989 SetInvisibleButtonChrome(Button);
2990 }
2991 RepairMercenaryPortraitFrame(Target.Key, PortraitFrameTexture);
2992 }
2993 if (UWidget* ArtifactStrip =
2994 HudBlueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("ArtifactStrip")))
2995 {
2996 HudBlueprint->WidgetTree->RemoveWidget(ArtifactStrip);
2997 }
2998 BuildEnemyAPPips(HudBlueprint);
2999 PruneStaleVariables(HudBlueprint);
3000 PruneStaleVariables(MercenaryBlueprint);
3001
3002 const bool bHudSaved = SaveCompiledBlueprint(HudBlueprint);
3003 const bool bMercenarySaved = SaveCompiledBlueprint(MercenaryBlueprint);
3004 if (bHudSaved == false || bMercenarySaved == false)
3005 {
3006 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD save failed"));
3007 return;
3008 }
3009 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Display,
3010 TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_INVENTORY_BUILD success assets=2"));
3011 }

3063 void DumpWidgetSlots(const TArray<FString>& Args)
3064 {
3065 UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = LoadObject<UWidgetBlueprint>(nullptr, AssetPath);
3066 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
3067 {
3068 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("RD_SLOT_DUMP missing WBP"));
3069 return;
3070 }
3071 const FString Filter = Args.IsEmpty() ? FString() : Args[0];
3072 int32 Printed = 0;
3073 Blueprint->WidgetTree->ForEachWidget([&Filter, &Printed](UWidget* Widget)
3074 {
3075 if (Widget == nullptr)
3076 {
3077 return;
3078 }
3079 const FString Name = Widget->GetName();
3080 if (Filter.IsEmpty() == false && Name.Contains(Filter) == false)
3081 {
3082 return;
3083 }
3084 const UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Widget->Slot);
3085 if (Slot == nullptr)
3086 {
3087 return;
3088 }
3089 const FAnchors Anchors = Slot->GetAnchors();
3090 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Display,
3091 TEXT("RD_SLOT %s|%s|pos=%.4f,%.4f|size=%.4f,%.4f|")
3092 TEXT("anchor=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f|align=%.3f,%.3f|z=%d|auto=%d"),
3093 *Name, *Widget->GetClass()->GetName(),
3094 Slot->GetPosition().X, Slot->GetPosition().Y,
3095 Slot->GetSize().X, Slot->GetSize().Y,
3096 Anchors.Minimum.X, Anchors.Minimum.Y,
3097 Anchors.Maximum.X, Anchors.Maximum.Y,
3098 Slot->GetAlignment().X, Slot->GetAlignment().Y,
3099 Slot->GetZOrder(), Slot->GetAutoSize() ? 1 : 0);
3100 ++Printed;
3101 });
3102 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Display, TEXT("RD_SLOT_DUMP done count=%d"), Printed);
3103 }

3261 void BuildMercenaryPanel(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, const FSlateFontInfo& BaseFont,
3262 UTexture2D* ShellTexture, UTexture2D* NormalCardTexture,
3263 UTexture2D* SelectedCardTexture, UTexture2D* BackButtonTexture,
3264 UTexture2D* SkillFrameTexture, UTexture2D* PortraitFrameTexture,
3265 UTexture2D* InventoryIconTexture,
3266 UTexture2D* GoldIconTexture, UTexture2D* DescriptionPlateTexture)
3267 {
3268 UCanvasPanel* Root = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget);
3269 UCanvasPanel* Panel = FindOrCreate<UCanvasPanel>(Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryPanel"));
3270 PlaceCanvas(Root, Panel, FVector2D::ZeroVector, FVector2D(1920.f, 1080.f), 10000);
3271 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* PanelSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Panel->Slot))
3272 {
3273 // The old Python pass left this as a 1920x1080 rectangle attached to the
3274 // top-left corner. On a small/wide mobile viewport the rectangle was
3275 // clipped and the live combat HUD leaked through on the right. The modal
3276 // shell owns the whole viewport; only its authored contents are aspect-fit.
3277 PanelSlot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
3278 PanelSlot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
3279 }
3280 Panel->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
3281
3282 UImage* Shell = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, TEXT("RuntimeMercenaryRosterShell"));
3283 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Shell, FVector2D(90.f, 70.f), FVector2D(1740.f, 960.f), -100);
3284 Shell->SetBrushFromTexture(ShellTexture, false);
3285 Shell->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::HitTestInvisible);
3286
3287 // 외곽 셸 자체가 배경을 제공한다. 별도의 불투명 검정 Well은 좁은
3288 // 화면에서 아래 16:9 Board와 서로 다른 배율을 받아 내용만 가렸다.
3289 // 예전 빌더가 만든 잔재도 지워 재빌드가 Photo1 회귀를 만들지 않게 한다.
3290 if (UWidget* ContentWell = Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(
3291 TEXT("MercenaryContentWell")))
3292 {
3293 Blueprint->WidgetTree->RemoveWidget(ContentWell);
3294 }
3295
3296 UBorder* Scrim = FindOrCreate<UBorder>(Blueprint, TEXT("MercenaryScrim"));
3297 PlaceCanvas(Panel, Scrim, FVector2D::ZeroVector, FVector2D(1920.f, 1080.f), -90);
3298 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* ScrimSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Scrim->Slot))
3299 {
3300 ScrimSlot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
3301 ScrimSlot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
3302 }
3303 Scrim->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::Collapsed);
3304
3305 UScaleBox* BoardScale = FindOrCreate<UScaleBox>(Blueprint,
3306 TEXT("MercenaryBoardScale"));
3307 PlaceCanvas(Panel, BoardScale, FVector2D::ZeroVector,
3308 FVector2D(1920.f, 1080.f), 1);
3309 if (UCanvasPanelSlot* ScaleSlot = Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(BoardScale->Slot))
3310 {
3311 ScaleSlot->SetAnchors(FAnchors(0.f, 0.f, 1.f, 1.f));
3312 ScaleSlot->SetOffsets(FMargin(0.f));
3313 }
3314 BoardScale->SetStretch(EStretch::ScaleToFit);
3315 BoardScale->SetStretchDirection(EStretchDirection::Both);
3316
3317 USizeBox* BoardSize = FindOrCreate<USizeBox>(Blueprint,
3318 TEXT("MercenaryBoardDesignSize"));
3319 BoardSize->SetWidthOverride(1920.f);
3320 BoardSize->SetHeightOverride(1080.f);

3548 struct FDetailText
3549 {
3550 const TCHAR* Name;
3551 FVector2D Position;
3552 FVector2D Size;
3553 const TCHAR* Preview;
3554 int32 FontSize;
3555 };
3556 /*
3557 * 이름만 글자로 두고 수치 셋은 **칩**으로 옮긴다.
3558 *
3559 * "HP 100 / 100" 을 세 줄로 쌓아 놓으니 오른쪽 위가 글자 벽이 됐고,
3560 * 정작 아래 스킬 칸과 결이 달랐다. 상세창·몬스터탭이 이미 칩을 쓰므로
3561 * 같은 물건으로 맞춘다 -- 같은 값은 같은 모양으로 보여야 한다.
3562 */
3563 const FDetailText Details[] = {
3564 { TEXT("MercenaryDetailName"), FVector2D(1080.f, 230.f), FVector2D(620.f, 82.f), TEXT(""), 42 },
3565 };
3566 for (const FDetailText& Detail : Details)
3567 {
3568 UTextBlock* Text = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint, FName(Detail.Name));
3569 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, Text, Detail.Position, Detail.Size, 8);
3570 Text->SetText(FCString::Strlen(Detail.Preview) > 0
3571 ? FText::FromString(Detail.Preview)
3572 : NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "MercenaryDetailPreview", "용병"));
3573 SetReadableFont(Text, BaseFont, Detail.FontSize);
3574 Text->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Left);
3575 }
3576
3577 // 수치 칩 셋. 이름 바로 밑에 가로로 놓는다.
3578 const TCHAR* const ChipValueNames[3] = {
3579 TEXT("MercenaryDetailHP"), TEXT("MercenaryDetailAP"),
3580 TEXT("MercenaryDetailSpeed") };
3581 const FText ChipLabels[3] = { FText::FromString(TEXT("HP")),
3582 FText::FromString(TEXT("AP")),
3583 NSLOCTEXT("CombatHUD", "ChipSpeed", "속도") };
3584 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < 3; ++Index)
3585 {
3586 const FVector2D ChipPos(1080.f, 330.f + 82.f * Index);
3587 const FVector2D ChipSize(620.f, 68.f);
3588 UImage* Ring = FindOrCreate<UImage>(Blueprint, FName(*FString::Printf(
3589 TEXT("MercenaryChip%dFrame"), Index)));
3590 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, Ring, ChipPos, ChipSize, 8);
3591 Ring->SetBrushFromTexture(DescriptionPlateTexture, false);
3592 Ring->SetVisibility(ESlateVisibility::SelfHitTestInvisible);
3593 UTextBlock* Label = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint, FName(*FString::Printf(
3594 TEXT("MercenaryChip%dLabel"), Index)));
3595 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, Label, ChipPos + FVector2D(38.f, 4.f),
3596 FVector2D(145.f, 58.f), 9);
3597 Label->SetText(ChipLabels[Index]);
3598 SetReadableFont(Label, BaseFont, 27);
3599 Label->SetJustification(ETextJustify::Left);
3600
3601 UTextBlock* Value = FindOrCreate<UTextBlock>(Blueprint, FName(ChipValueNames[Index]));
3602 PlaceCanvas(DetailSection, Value, ChipPos + FVector2D(205.f, 4.f),
3603 FVector2D(360.f, 58.f), 9);
3604 Value->SetText(FText::FromString(TEXT("-")));
3605 SetReadableFont(Value, BaseFont, 30);
3606 }

3610 FVector2D(620.f, 68.f), 8);

3687 void Build()
3688 {
3689 UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = LoadObject<UWidgetBlueprint>(nullptr, AssetPath);
3690 if (Blueprint == nullptr || Blueprint->WidgetTree == nullptr)
3691 {
3692 UE_LOG(LogTemp, Error, TEXT("RD_COMBAT_HUD_BUILD missing asset %s"), AssetPath);
3693 return;
3694 }
3695 Blueprint->Modify();
3696 Blueprint->WidgetTree->Modify();
3697
3698 UCanvasPanel* Objective = CastChecked<UCanvasPanel>(
3699 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("ObjectivePanel")));
3700 UTextBlock* RoundText = CastChecked<UTextBlock>(
3701 Blueprint->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("RoundText")));
3702 const FSlateFontInfo BaseFont = RoundText->GetFont();
3703
3704 UTexture2D* MercenaryTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
3705 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Marchbound/Combat/T_MB_OptionsIcon_MercenaryGlyph.T_MB_OptionsIcon_MercenaryGlyph"));
3706 UTexture2D* MonsterTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
3707 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Marchbound/Combat/T_MB_OptionsIcon_MonsterGlyph.T_MB_OptionsIcon_MonsterGlyph"));
3708 UTexture2D* TurnTokenFrameTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
3709 TEXT("/Game/UI/Generated/CombatHUD/T_MB_TurnToken_Frame_NoSpeed_v1.T_MB_TurnToken_Frame_NoSpeed_v1"));
3710 UTexture2D* OptionsRailFrameTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
3711 OptionsRailFrameTexturePath);
3712 UTexture2D* MapTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
3713 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Marchbound/Combat/T_MB_OptionsIcon_Map.T_MB_OptionsIcon_Map"));
3714 UTexture2D* SettingsTexture = LoadObject<UTexture2D>(nullptr,
3715 TEXT("/Game/SVN/OutSideAsset/AICreation/UI/Marchbound/Combat/T_MB_OptionsIcon_Settings.T_MB_OptionsIcon_Settings"));
